notes.title: Patch 1.1 Preview - New Orbs of Transformation
notes.content:
[p]Hunters,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share a sneak peek at [b]Patch 1.1[/b], coming later this September! [/p][p][/p][p]We already finished the [b]Dark Mode, and it’s now fully implemented across all screens[/b]! Your eyes can finally rest easy while you’re blasting through missions, tinkering with builds, or exploring the galaxy.[/p][p][/p][p]But that’s not all! Patch 1.1 also brings [b]3 new Orbs of Transformation[/b] and updates to the [b]Justin Material Exchange Shop[/b], giving you more ways to get rarer Materials and advanced Orbs.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Orbs 🪐[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Binding Orb [/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/3606da72282d6f37afbd8566a180635c6f0ade16.png"][/img][/p][p]Bound by mechanical rings, its power seals what it touches against alteration.
Applying this Orb on an item will lock one Affix, with a small chance of selecting a second Affix on Tier 4 Items.[/p][p][/p][p]A Locked Affix will not be changed when using other Orbs. Use this to Lock in a Super Affix or an Affix that you really want to keep.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Paradox Orb[/b][/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/9c50e1cf5147124415b071e97a17a6627d24d4d6.png"][/img][b]
[/b] [/h2][p][/p][p]Purple arcs dance across fractured planes, bending reality into unpredictable outcomes. Applying this Orb on an item will have unexpected consequences. Some of them might even be positive.[/p][p]
[b]Warning:[/b] the item will become Unstable and will no longer accept any modifications from the Item Workshop or from other Orbs, with the exception of the Harmony Orb, which removes the Unstable state.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Harmony Orb[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/88f69470698bd1c2a997227064cc9bb27c34033b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]
[/b]A sphere of calming emerald-like light, weaving broken matter back into wholeness. Using this Orb on an Unstable item will remove any Paradox Affixes and restore any Disabled Affixes. The item will no longer be Unstable.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Justin Material Exchange Shop changes 💱[/b][/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Purchase Orbs with T4 Materials and Memories.
[/p][/*][*][p]Convert High-end Materials for other ones (i.e: convert 50x Set Emblems for 25x Augmentation Modules).
[/p][/*][*][p]Trade in a bunch of Shifting Orbs for any other Orb.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Patch 1.1 is offering new tools to take your builds even further. We can’t wait to see the new strategies you’ll bring to the galaxy.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you, as always, for your patience and support. Stay tuned for the full release at the [b]end of September[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p][i]Relic Hunters Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 1.0 Hotfix 1 is Live
notes.content:
[p]Hey Hunters,  Quick hotfix after a couple of days of the 1.0 launch. The game is looking very stable across the board, both in multiplayer and single-player. The main concern at the moment seems to be the brightness of the menus, so we are working on a solution and hope to have more information for you today.  The hotfix changes are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Stats Screen was causing massive framerate spikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Ace's Flurry Skill Node Buff now appropriately buffs Critical Damage (it was actually reducing the stat).[/p][/*][*][p]Raff's Wrench and Keytar Blast damage displayed on tooltip updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Paradoxal Heart's Affix has been translated to all languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Contagion explanation given by DeathanatorX has been updated on all languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Duducan Ducannon name has been translated to all languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue on Memory Tooltip that would fail to properly display the active Hunter's name in Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p]Demo progress will now properly be transferred to full game version (this broke on the last demo published). This will either happen automatically or will display a message for the player to let them know they can transfer the progress via the Support menu.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Fight on![/p][p]~The Relic Hunters Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.15.1 is Live - Bug Fixes, Weapon Swapping Improvements & Balance Tweaks
notes.content: [p]Hey Hunters! [/p][p]Thank you so much for all the reports and feedback you've shared with us over the past weeks. Your input has been crucial in helping us polish the game and deliver this update. Patch [b]0.15.1[/b] is now live, and while it’s not a major content drop, it includes fixes and improvements that directly address issues spotted by the community. [/p][p]Check out the full patch notes below 👇[/p][h1] 🐞 Bug Fixes[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Early Access exclusive badge should no longer disappear from time to time.[/p][/*][*][p]Distraction Missions affected by Challenges should now properly end before the timer runs out once all enemies are defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]Kami Freak's Loot Table has been fixed and it will now drop Thorns as expected.[/p][/*][*][p]Potion overtime healing effect no longer accumulates duration upon successive uses.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug that would cause characters to keep flipping directions while preparing a Charge Skill and aiming too close to their feet.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]🛠️ Improvements[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Mouse Scroll Wheel can now be used to swap between weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse Scroll Wheel Up/Down can both be rebinded to other Actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Option to toggle Version Number visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Toggle Story Auto Advance Option has been moved to become part of the Story Auto Advance Speed Option.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]⚙️ Tweaks and Changes[/h1][p][/p][list][*][p]Ace's Finisher Skill Node now grants +(3 to 24)% Added Fire Damage during Donkey From Above and Rocketeer.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Hot Trigger Fire Damage per stack from 3 to 4%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Firestarter's Fire Damage buff from 60 to 80%, decreases non-fire damage by 40% (was 30%).[/p][/*][*][p]Contagion now reduces affected target's Resistances by 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Fire and Frag Condition Damage Scaling increased from 10% to 25% of Base damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Toxic Friend reduces enemy resistances by 70% (was 75%).[/p][/*][*][p]SMG Weapon Type Base Damage increased from 15 to 16.[/p][/*][*][p]Hot Trigger Base Damage increased to 23.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! We’ll keep working to improve the experience and will continue listening closely to your feedback. [/p][p]See you on this galaxy![/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/633b6203fab28b784c375f1069d39070b0ba7afb.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

[p]Hey, Hunters![/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.15 is here, bringing one feature to our completionist community: [b]the Compendium[/b]! Now you can [b]recycle them into Timeless Essence[/b]!

notes.title: Update on the 1.0 Launch Date & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hunters,

At the beginning of this year, we announced our plans to release Relic Hunters Legend simultaneously on PC and Xbox, aiming for a Q2 2025 launch. However, we’ve recently encountered some [b]unexpected and serious challenges with the porting process to Xbox[/b]. As a small indie team with limited resources, ensuring the same level of quality and excellence across all platforms is a top priority for us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/13e49def37937bdc2bd44be853ab1a41f25ffc0b.png[/img]
[i]Us (Ace) begging the Xbox port (Jimmy) to behave.[/i]

After careful consideration, we’ve made the difficult decision to [b]delay the 1.0 launch to Q3 2025[/b]. This wasn’t easy—but we believe it’s the right choice to give the game the second chance it deserves and allow more players to discover this heartfelt adventure about time travel, friendship, and reclaiming lost memories.

The game’s final content is already complete. What we need now is just a little more time to polish the experience on Xbox and make sure everything runs as smoothly as it should. We want every player—regardless of platform—to have the best possible experience on Day One.

We’re incredibly grateful for the continued support of our community throughout this journey. We know it’s been a long road, and we’ve faced many unexpected challenges, but Relic Hunters Legend is one of our most ambitious projects yet. We owe it to our players to release it in the best shape it can be.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. The wait won’t be much longer, and we promise it will be worth it. ❤️

_____

[h1]0.14.1 Patch Notes[/h1]

We’re continuously improving the Relic Hunters Legend experience, and while we prepare for launch, we’ve just released a new patch with exciting updates for you to enjoy — all thanks to the valuable reports and suggestions from our amazing community on [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Discord[/url] and Steam.

Check out what’s new below! 👇

[h2]General Improvements and Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Nanocloak has been redesigned to increase Dodge Chance by 100% (goes above cap) for 5 seconds when using an Utility Skill. Firing weapons or using Skills will cancel the effect immediately.
[*] Tower Bells has been redesigned to remove Stun and Freeze effects from the player, while causing the same effect to enemies nearby. Can only happen once at every 20 seconds.
[*] Ultimate Skills can now be cancelled by pressing the same button that activates it once the Intro has ended.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause permanent Freeze and Stun when duration was next to 0.
[*] Fixed Multiple Special Missions sometimes occupying the same Mission.
[*] Fixed Special Missions completion not being tracked.
[*] Seven's Frogsuit Hair has now been fixed and properly looks like the icon suggests.
[*] Fixed some UI terms that had no localization (such as the DODGE text when you dodge stuff).
[/list]

[h2]Party Short Code[/h2]

[list]
[*] Parties now have a short code that allows others to join by inputting them into the Social Window. This will be extremely useful for cross-platform Parties!
[*] You'll now see a Steam icon with your display name.
[/list]

[h2]Ace Tweaks[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased radius of the damage (and combo priming effect) caused by Ace's Jetpack Skill, and added a new visual effect.
[*] Ace's Hot Sauce Skill Node now also causes the Holo-Sandwich to trigger its explosion immediately when Ace is close enough.
[/list]

[h2]Panzer Tweaks[/h2]

[list]
[*] We've made a few changes to Panzer to improve her survivability. Here are the changes:
[*] Intimidating Presence Blue Skill Node has been designed to grant Overshields when hitting enemies with Can't Catch Me.
[*] Pointy Teeth Blue Skill Node no longer requires Overshields in order to Stun enemies. Stun chance has also been increased and can now reach 100%.
[*] Pressure Point Blue Skill Node has been redesigned, it now causes Bite to inflict extra Fire Damage on enemies affected by Burn.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png[/img]

We’re always keeping a close eye on our communities across Discord and Steam to keep improving the experience with Relic Hunters Legend. Your feedback makes all the difference, and we’re excited to keep making the game even better with you!

Thanks again for all the support and see you in the galaxy!

— The Rogue Snail Team
[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/bf9c473e4367bc9c04cc12702b3a4a3bab0bb90d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Patch 0.14 – ADN Rework is Here!
notes.content:
Hunters, get ready! 

The Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis (ADN) is getting a major overhaul in Patch 0.14, bringing a more dynamic, challenging, and rewarding experience to endgame players. We've reimagined ADN to provide better pacing, fresh mission variety, and meaningful rewards to make your time spent in the dungeon more exciting.

[h1]What's New in the ADN Rework?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/4c0dfce8725cd3406e6a75a81e1de333b4005529.gif[/img]

[h2]🔄 Shorter Cycles [/h2]

Tired of waiting a full week for the next ADN cycle? We've shortened the reset time from 7 days to just 3 days, giving you more frequent opportunities to farm, progress, and get more rewards!

[h2]⚔️ Difficulty Revamp[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Regular ADN: [/b] Redesigned to become more accessible and rewarding. Enemy levels now range from 35–45, ensuring a smoother difficulty curve for all players.
[*] [b]Greater ADN:[/b] This high-level challenge has been redesigned to be soloable and extra challenging.
[/list] 

[h2]🎯 More Missions, More Rewards![/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]12 Missions Added:[/b] We’ve expanded the ADN mission pool to keep things fresh while retiring older, less engaging missions.
[*] [b]Greater ADN as the True Pinnacle Activity: [/b]Expect the ultimate test of skill with missions that require well-optimized builds and top-tier execution. Conquering these challenges will earn you an exclusive banner title.
[*] [b]Better Rewards: [/b]Greater ADN rewards are now focused on late-endgame build tweaking stuff, such as the new Orbs and Crystallized Time.
[/list]

[h2]🛡️ New Gameplay Mechanics[/h2]

[b]Resistance Debuff:[/b] ADN now introduces a resistance debuff system, requiring you to balance your offense and defense to survive. Prepare your builds wisely!

[h2]🛠️ Orbs of Modification[/h2]

New item type for modifying Gear pieces and Weapons.

[list]
[*] [b]Shifting Orb:[/b] Rerolls selected item’s Affixes, except High-end ones (Augmented, Set, or Legendary).
[*] [b]Utopic Orb:[/b] Ultra Rare Orb that rerolls Super Affixes.
[*] Orbs drop from Champions and end-of-mission Chests (drop rates increase based on mission Timeline).
[*] Utopic Orb is exclusive to one of the Greater ADN Floors.
[/list]
___________________________________________________

[h1]📝 Change Log for Patch 0.14[/h1]

[h2]🎮 What's New[/h2]

[h3]🔥 Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis 2.0[/h3]

[list]
[*] Cycle Duration is now 3 Days (was 7).
[*] Each cycle offers 5 Missions for both Regular and Greater difficulties.
[*] We've added 12 new Missions and removed 2 old ones, adding to a total of 15 Missions. Missions will rotate randomly every Cycle.
[/list]

[h3]🏹 Regular Floors[/h3]

[list]
[*] Missions rebalanced for better accessibility and rewards.
[*] Regular Missions now always have one Minor Challenge.
[*] Regular Missions now reduce all Resistances by 15%.
[/list]

[h3]💀 Greater Floors[/h3]

[list]
[*] Greater Missions provide late-endgame build tweaking materials, including the new Utopic Orb and Fashion Credits.
[*] Greater Missions now reduce all Resistances by 30%.
[*] They now always have one Major Challenge and one Minor Challenge.
[*] [b]New Chapter: [/b]Hunter Zero 3, featuring a prestigious Banner and Title for those who complete every Greater ADN Mission.
[/list]

[h3]🚀 Augmented Affixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Two new Augmented Affixes have been added to allow players to be able to increase their resistances cap from 50% to 80%.
[*] Elemental: Increases Max Elemental Resistances by 30%.
[*] Phyiscal: Increases Max Physical Resistances by 30%.
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ Orbs of Modification[/h3]

[list]
[*] New item type for modifying Gear pieces and Weapons.
[*] [b]Shifting Orb:[/b] Rerolls selected item’s Affixes, except High-end ones (Augmented, Set, or Legendary).
[*] [b]Utopic Orb:[/b] Ultra Rare Orb that rerolls Super Affixes.
[*] Orbs drop from Champions and end-of-mission Chests (drop rates increase based on mission Timeline).
[*] Utopic Orb is exclusive to one of the Greater ADN Floors.
[/list]

[h3]🔧 Fixes and Tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[*] Storage Screen now has filters to help you find your items.
[*] Item's Tooltips now display who can equip each item as well as who is equipping it.
[*] It's now possible to hide the HUD during gameplay by pressing F2.
[*] New UI display for Special Mission and ADN Challenges.
[*] New Icon for Timeless Essence.
[*] T4 Materials removed from Treasure Chests and replaced with a mix of Wishful Fragments, Crystallized Time, and Shifting Orbs.
[*] Cartographer’s Shards from Faction Quests increased by 50%.
[*] Fixed a bug where Difficulty Stats bonuses/penalties were not applied in the first match.
[*] Non-Champion enemies now have a cap to Reduced Duration Stats.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Talking Head VO's not to play at times.
[*] Fixed a bug where characters did not play Emotes during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed a bug that would make it impossible to purchase new Outfit Palettes if above a certain amount of Dye Kits.
[*] It's no longer possible to Dodge self inflicted damage, such as Overdriver's.
[*] It's no longer possible to Dodge falling damage.
[*] Reduced base radius for Raff's Deadly Drop to 6 (was 4).
[*] Ace's Rocket Fist now only plays Ace's VO line 20% of the times.
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing Jimmy's Perfect Angle to lose a stack when firing Beam Rifles.
[*] Increased Thunder Cannon's chain lightning cooldown to prevent it from starting a stack overflow when combined with Jimmy's Perfect Angle.
[*] Trying to collect Materials and Memories that are already at the Cap will now display a warning and bounce off the drop back to the world.
[*] Increased the amount of Cartographers Shards dropped from completing a Treasure Map.
[*] Increased the amount of Cartographers Shards dropped by defeating Champions on Treasure Maps.
[*] Increased Cartographers Shards Cap from 9999 to 99999.

[/list]

[h3]🎁 Special Mission Rewards Adjustments[/h3]

[b]Hard Timeline:[/b]
Alien Carapaces: 8 (was 4)
Nanometal: 16 (was 6)
Energy Core: 4 (was 1)
Strange Goo: 4 (was 1)
Cartographer’s Shards: 400 (was 1200)
The amound of Hard Special Missions was reduced from 4 to 3.

[b]Epic Timeline:[/b]
Alien Carapaces: 16 (was 6)
Nanometal: 16 (was 6)
Energy Core: 8 (was 4)
Strange Goo: 8 (was 4)
Cartographer’s Shards: 800 (was 4000)
The amound of Epic Special Missions was increased from 1 to 2.

📝 Cartographer’s Shards were too abundant due to a bug that multiplied rewards. We’ve fixed the bug and increased both the drop rates and the number of shards per completed Faction Quest by 50% to compensate.

We’re excited to see how you tackle these new challenges, Hunters! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we can’t wait to hear what you think of the revamped ADN experience.
Let us know your thoughts, and as always, happy hunting!

We’re excited to share that Relic Hunters Legend is part of the Made in Brazil Sale, featuring our biggest discount ever—[b]40% off![/b] 🎉 This is the best time to grab the game before we increase the price for our 1.0 final launch. If you've been waiting for the perfect moment to jump in, this is it!

Still on the fence? No problem! We’re also making a[b] Demo available[/b] so you can experience the first hours of gameplay before making your decision. We want you to have fun and feel confident that Relic Hunters Legend is the right game for you!

[h1]More Brazilian Games to Discover! 🇧🇷[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/9292aeab3c7d07b55a4aff2c838480b7e975b5d8.png[/img]

Over the years, we’ve faced many challenges, but our commitment to Relic Hunters Legend has never wavered. We’ve worked tirelessly to refine the game, improve its systems, and address the feedback you’ve shared with us. Every update, fix, and feature we’ve added has been driven by our passion for this project and our belief in making it the best experience possible.

Your support has been essential in shaping Relic Hunters Legend into what it is today. If you’re enjoying the game,[b] leaving a review helps immensely[/b]! It keeps the game relevant, brings in new players, and ensures that we can continue improving and expanding the experience.

Now more than ever, we need your help to reach the right players who would love to be part of this adventure. Thank you for standing by us, for sharing your thoughts, and for being part of this incredible journey. We couldn’t have made it this far without you!

See you in the Galaxy, Hunters! 🚀

notes.title: Patch 0.13.1 has come! Exquisite Shop, new currencies, and Improvements
notes.content:
Hunters,

We’re kicking off the year with Patch 0.13.1, a smaller update packed with bug fixes, tweaks, and new features to enhance your adventure! This patch is all about fine-tuning your experience, addressing community feedback, and laying the groundwork for even more improvements in the months ahead.

Here’s what’s waiting for you in this update:

[h1]🛒 New Exquisite Items Shop[/h1]

Now The Stranger at the End of Time is your go-to for World Drop Legendaries and Uniques, offering a  new way to expand your arsenal.

[h1]💎 New Currencies for Better Loot Control[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Wishful Fragments:[/b] Use these to purchase World Drop Legendaries. Earn them as rewards from Special Missions, Rebel Ranks, Treasure Chests, and World Drops.
[*] [b]Crystallized Time:[/b] Trade these for World Drop Uniques. Collect them by recycling Uniques and completing Special Missions. Plus, keep an eye out for how this currency will tie into February’s ADN rework!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/72f75535154c94a3123eb8236dac158d60fbed4c.png[/img]

[h1]🔧 Fixes and Quality of Life Tweaks[/h1]

Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us squash bugs and improve gameplay!

[list]
[*] [b]Cartographer's Faction Shop[/b] now offers all L1 maps, making it easier to target farm the Treasure Chests you need.
[*] [b]New icons[/b] for Augmentation Modules, Set Emblems, and Exotic Lining
[/list]

[b]A range of bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Smoothed out aiming issues that would cause aiming during charging on gamepads to move unpredictably sometimes.
[*] Fixed minimap icon colors in the Secret Market.
[*] Resolved bugs causing soft freezes in Field Research (Don't Pet my Kami) missions.
[*] Addressed animation bug that would occur if Seven used Blink during their Ultimate.
[*] Fixed a few issues related to Distraction game mode announcements
[*] Resolved Kami Spit's projectile that was getting destroyed before it should
[*] Grandpa Chronos won’t be double-booked in the Homecoming Story Mission anymore!
[/list]

[h1]Looking Ahead[/h1]

As we polish Relic Hunters Legend, updates like these are crucial in delivering the experience you deserve. We’re committed to improving the game based on your feedback, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on these changes.

We want to hear from you! Let us know what you think of Patch 0.13.1 and share your suggestions for what you’d like to see next.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. Your support fuels our passion, and we’re excited to bring you more adventures, improvements, and surprises in the coming months.

[url=https://discord.gg/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/bf9c473e4367bc9c04cc12702b3a4a3bab0bb90d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Exciting News: Relic Hunters Legend is Coming to Xbox!
notes.content:
[quote=Rogue Snail Team][h1]⚠️ IMPORTANT REMINDER: Migrate Your Progress by January 2025![/h1]

Don't miss out! After this month, servers will be deactivated, and your progress won't be recoverable. Take action now to secure your adventure in Relic Hunters Legend!  [/quote]

Hunters!

We’re thrilled to announce that Relic Hunters Legend will launch simultaneously on PC and Xbox! This incredible milestone means that players will soon be able to enjoy the game on both PC and Xbox, but with this exciting news comes some necessary adjustments to our roadmap.

To accommodate the process of porting the game to Xbox, we’ve updated our release schedule to ensure the best experience possible across all platforms. While this has shifted some dates, we’re confident it’s for the best reason imaginable: bringing Relic Hunters Legend to a whole new audience while maintaining our commitment to quality.

[h1]Updated Roadmap Highlights[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/19513fe3da6c308a2beedda80647fb33c89463cd.png[/img]

[h2]January: Patch 0.13.1[/h2]

This smaller update focuses on bug fixes and adjustments based on the incredible feedback we’ve received since Patch 0.13, while also introducing exciting new features for itemization and endgame. So you’ll be able to check it out later this week:


[b]New Exquisite Items Shop[/b]: 
A specialized shop where you can buy World Drop Legendaries and Uniques from The Stranger at the End of Time.

[b]New Currencies:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wishful Fragments: Used to purchase World Drop Legendaries. These can be earned as rewards from Special Missions, Rebel Ranks, Treasure Chests, and general World Drops.
[*] Crystalized Time: Used to purchase World Drop Uniques. Earned by recycling Uniques and completing Special Missions. This currency will also part of the new rewards  in the ADN update next month.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/72f75535154c94a3123eb8236dac158d60fbed4c.png[/img]

[b]Fixes and Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cartographer's Faction Shop now sells all L1 maps, so you can better target farm the Treasure Chest of your choice.
[*] New icons for Augmentation Modules, Set Emblems and Exotic Lining.
[*] Fixed issue that would cause aiming during charging on gamepads to move unpredictably sometimes.
[*] Fixed minimap icon's sometimes being painted the wrong color on the Secret Market.
[*] Fixed two bugs that would cause Field Research (Don't Pet my Kami) to sometimes soft freeze.
[*] Fixed visual animation bug that would occur if Seven used Blink during their Ultimate.
[*] Fixed a few issues related to Distraction game mode announcements.
[*] Fixed Kami Spit's projectile, it was getting destroyed before it should.
[*] Fixed issue that would spawn a second Grandpa Chronos during Homecoming Story Mission.
[/list]


[h2]February: Patch 0.14 – ADN Rework[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/068d830bc64f7fda6ed7e5302cac6f966aa19da1.png[/img]

The Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis (ADN) has been reimagined to provide a more dynamic and rewarding endgame experience. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Shorter Cycles for Engagement:[/b]
ADN cycles will now reset every 3 days instead of 7, allowing for more frequent opportunities to farm and progress.


[*][b]Difficulty Revamp:[/b]
- [b]Regular ADN: [/b]Enemy levels adjusted to range between 35–45, offering a more accessible experience for all players.
- [b]Greater ADN: [/b]Redesigned to be a solo or duo activity, catering to players who prefer either single-player gameplay or working with one trusted companion. We’re committed to enhancing the experience for all playstyles, whether you enjoy going solo or playing cooperatively.

[*][b]Improved Mission Variety and Rewards:[/b]

- [b]15 Missions[/b]: Adding more variety to the ADN experience while retiring older, less engaging missions.
- Greater ADN will now act as the true [b]Pinnacle Activity,[/b] requiring well-thought-out builds and strong execution to conquer. Success in these missions will reward you with [b]unique banners, and titles[/b].
- Rewards across ADN have been improved, including increased [b]T4 Material Drops [/b]and new currencies for better progression.

[*] [b]New Gameplay Mechanics:[/b]
 ADN now introduces a Resistance Debuff, requiring players to better balance offensive and defensive stats



[h2]Looking Ahead: Early Q2 Final Launch[/h2]

Our final launch has been adjusted to [b]early Q2 2025[/b] to allow ample time for both the Xbox porting process and the continued refinement of gameplay features.

It’s important to note that with our last transition to local saves, players won’t be able to share their saves between Xbox and PC. While this was a necessary decision to ensure smooth gameplay on all platforms, we’re committed to providing an outstanding experience wherever you choose to play. Stay tuned for more updates about Xbox portability in the near future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png[/img]

Your unwavering support has been the backbone of our journey. Despite the challenges we’ve faced, we’ve poured our hearts and souls into Relic Hunters Legend, and we couldn’t have done it without you.

As we approach the final stretch, your feedback will remain invaluable. Let’s continue this adventure together as we shape the future of the game. Thank you for being part of this incredible journey.

[b]💬 Share your thoughts and stay tuned for more news![/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/633b6203fab28b784c375f1069d39070b0ba7afb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Retrospective 2024: What a YEAR for Relic Hunters Legend
notes.content:
[quote=Rogue Snail Team] [h3][b]⚠️ IMPORTANT REMINDER: Migrate Your Progress by January 2025! [/b][/h3]

[i]Don't miss out! After this month, servers will be deactivated, and your progress won't be recoverable. Take action now to secure your adventure in Relic Hunters Legend![/i]  [/quote]

The year 2024 was undoubtedly one of the most transformative and challenging years in the history of Relic Hunters Legend. 

With many challenges overcome, bold changes, and the invaluable support of our community, we continued building the game of our dreams. Here’s a complete retrospective of the achievements and key moments we experienced this year:

[h2]February: Treasure Maps Public Playtest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/83a4978dc9dd9af8c2b4711bd3e9aa3a935e1bca.gif[/img]

We kicked off the year by testing the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/7155726611389745535?l=english]Treasure Maps[/url] feature with a public playtest. 

This event also included item balance updates, unique icons, and new Relics, which were critical for gathering community feedback. The suggestions we received helped fine-tune the experience before the official feature launch.

[h2]March: Panzer Joins the Team & Treasure Maps Patch[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f5754eafa0577534cc3d54a9b7f4e3ca0ef9d364.gif[/img]

March saw the arrival of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/4101162602043785134?l=english]Panzer[/url], the Relic Hunters' mascot, with her unique skill set. 

We also released the [b]Treasure Maps[/b], which included adjustments based on playtest feedback, and introduced a new faction: [b]The Cartographers[/b], who help players explore treasure maps.

[h2]May: Offline Mode Debuts[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/b21101142be5bef0aab2b3cf793a9aa373a580fb.gif[/img]

Responding to community requests, we began rolling out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/4172100635497384743?l=english]Offline Mode[/url]. Major changes were made to the game’s story progression, allowing players to advance at their own pace without unnecessary restrictions. The campaign’s beginning was reworked, shortening its length and adjusting early Rebel Rank chapters for better accessibility.

We also introduced a new way to unlock Hunters using [b]Hunter Tokens[/b], implemented a revamped character selection screen, and reworked the way to acquire Kindness currency and Ascendant keys, which are now purchasable in the Stranger Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/b2ea53930662bdf4fabafbd3d9018c69564893dd.gif[/img]

[h2]June: New Horizons[/h2]

We announced our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/4188989767908077835?l=english]separation from the publisher[/url]—a challenging but necessary step to reaffirm our creative vision. Thanks to the community’s support, we overcame industry challenges and continued shaping Relic Hunters Legend’s future with more freedom and focus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/77672b12ed89d97948602f4ea375d4c821f0a1c9.png[/img]

[h2]August: Transition to Premium & Local Saves[/h2]

We revealed the game’s transition from Free-to-Play to a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/4597699678373734191?l=english]premium model [/url][b]priced at $20 at launch[/b]. This decision also allowed us to remove the online-only requirement. Progress is now saved locally with Steam Cloud Save support. Additionally, we introduced save slots for up to five accounts per device, supporting progress both offline and online.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/31dbc24b6e5d1d49e634c7d71ef9a758eb94a83e.jpg[/img]

[h2]September: Patch 0.11 Brings Core Improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/a7d6ffcebef7691f45fc5f1d204c79ed15662e86.jpg[/img]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/4684395873649407203?l=english]Patch 0.11[/url] delivered the first implementations of announced improvements:

[list]
[*] [b]New Save System[/b]: Play solo offline or multiplayer online, retaining progress in both modes.
[*] [b]Cosmetics Overhaul[/b]: Conversion of old currencies to [b]Fashion Credits[/b], with all skins available in the Stranger Shop.
[*] [b]Revamped Help Others[/b]: Now you receive a Buff for staying close to your teammates, leading to extra Kindness rewards at the end of the mission and we removed the Kindness Weekly Cap
[/list]


[h2]October: Patch 0.12 - Super Affixes & New Combo System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/c4ffb929ccb5cacf64ac071cccbb5cda4ca1ac7f.gif[/img]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/4512136358584648294?l=english]Patch 0.12[/url] introduced:

[list]
[*] [b]Super Affixes:[/b] Boost item power by 30-50%, with higher drop rates in high-level missions.
[*] [b]Storage Expansion:[/b] Increased storage space for up to 200 items.
[*] [b]New Steam Achievements:[/b] 18 retroactive achievements, with two reserved for the 1.0 launch.
[*] [b]New Combo System:[/b] Any Hunter can now perform Combos solo, with detonations varying based on each character’s damage type.
[/list]

[h2]December: Patch 0.13 & New Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/712170a38a650a6dffe39b6b99b604e9be617978.gif[/img]

We ended the year with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/523077531348239650?l=english]Patch 0.13[/url], which included:

[list]
[*] [b]Grandpa Chronos Workshop:[/b] A Crafting system for modding items, upgrading item tier and rarity, allowing for more personalized builds.
[*] [b]Challenge Mode:[/b] High-difficulty missions with T4 materials as rewards, 10 new Major Challenges and 8 new Set Affixes for unique playstyles.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png[/img]

This year, we also participated in several exciting events, including [b]Gamescom LATAM[/b], where Relic Hunters Legend was a finalist at the BIG Festival. We were honored to be part of the [b]DEVGamm Awards[/b], the [b]ANIMAI Festival[/b] - Festival Baiano de Animação e Games, proudly taking home awards for [b]Best Game[/b], [b]Best Audio[/b], and [b]Best Art[/b]. Oh, and let's not forget our prestigious participation at the [b]TGAGWCAGA 2024[/b]—The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards! 

None of this would have been possible without you, our community. In a year full of challenges, your patience, feedback, and support kept us going. We hope you’ll continue with us in 2025, enjoying the new content we’re preparing and helping us make Relic Hunters Legend even better.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Here’s to an amazing 2025! 🚀

notes.title: Patch 0.13 is here!🎉
notes.content:
Hunters, the wait is over! 🎉 Patch 0.13 has officially landed, bringing exciting new features, powerful customization tools, and improvements based on your feedback. With Grandpa Chronos’ Workshop now open, Challenge Mode unleashed, and a host of tweaks and fixes, there’s never been a better time to jump back into the action. 

Let’s dive into what’s new:

_______________

[h1]🚀 What’s New?[/h1]

[h2]🔧 Grandpa Chronos’ Workshop[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/712170a38a650a6dffe39b6b99b604e9be617978.gif[/img]

Grandpa Chronos has set up shop, bringing powerful tools to help you craft and customize your dream loadout! Here’s what you can do:

[list]
[*] [b]Item Modding:[/b] Take control of your gear like never before by adding new affixes to your weapons and equipment. Want more critical hits, elemental damage, or better survivability? Modify your items with specific stats to match your playstyle!
[*][b] Tier Upgrading:[/b] Boost your gear’s level and unlock its maximum potential for tougher challenges.
[*][b] Rarity Upgrading:[/b] Transform your items into Exotic or Augmented tiers, unlocking their true power and granting access to incredible bonuses.
[/list]

Take your build to the next level with Grandpa Chronos’ innovative crafting system!

[h2]🔥 Challenge Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/61fd3f8132371b5b3f7b7da46b88c56c52a0834b.png[/img]

Put your skills to the test with [b]Challenge Mode[/b]—a new way to play Missions with higher stakes and new rewards.

Activate Challenge Mode on any mission in the Broken Timeline to:

[list]
[*] Scale the mission to [b]level 50[/b] for maximum quality loot rolls.
[*] Farm [b]T4 materials[/b] without being restricted by timegates.
[*] Face[b] randomized challenges[/b] for unique gameplay experiences, keeping farming exciting and engaging.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/32a3da892f41325228797b33e68cc28560d560c6.png[/img]

This system eliminates the need to grind lower-level missions for high-level rewards and ensures every run feels worthwhile. It also includes:

[h3]⚔️ 10 New Major Challenges[/h3]

Challenge Mode Missions now feature exclusive Major Challenges to ramp up the difficulty and fun:

[list]
[*] [b]Dry Bottles[/b]
[*] [b]Decaying Field[/b]
[*] [b]Min-Maxing[/b]
[*] [b]Mark of Retribution[/b]
[*] [b]Empire Strikes[/b]
[*] [b]Temporal Storm[/b]
[*] [b]Elite Guards[/b]
[*] [b]Timekeepers Invasion[/b]
[*] [b]Kami Invasion[/b]
[*] [b]Imperial Invasion[/b]
[/list]


[h3]🛡️ 8 New Set Affixes[/h3]

Build unique playstyles with these powerful new item sets:

[list]
[*] [b]Abapotim Legacy's Set[/b]
[*] [b]Sharpshooter's Set[/b]
[*] [b]Survivor's Set[/b]
[*] [b]Tinker’s Set[/b]
[*] [b]Space Rogue’s Set[/b]
[*] [b]Trash Queen’s Set[/b]
[*] [b]Endless’ Set[/b]
[*] [b]Skirmisher’s Set[/b]
[/list]

[h3]🐞 Fixes & Improvements[/h3]

We’ve squashed bugs and tweaked mechanics to enhance your gameplay:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that was causing [b]Stun and Freeze Duration Reduction[/b] to not work properly.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause Pinkyy to not become[b] immune to Crowd Control during her Ultimate[/b].
[*] Fixed bug that would cause Ace's Scoundrel to not be applied at all.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause Raff's Crossfade to not apply the [b]appropriate bonus[/b] do Weapon Damage.
[*] Fixed one of Healing Mantle's Affix text, it was displaying Fire Damage instead of [b]Increased Healing[/b].
[*] Fixed T3 version of the All Attributes Affix, it now grants[b] all Attributes[/b] instead of just Agility.
[*] Fixed T4 Blitzkrieg's Base Damage to match its [b]T3 version[/b].
[*] Camera will [b]no longer lose focus[/b] of player character when getting interrupted during a Charge Skill (this happened only when using gamepads).
[*] Replaced Shop Token by [b]Fashion Credits[/b] at the Stranger's Shop. 
[*] Fixed Wild Mask's damage conversion. Any damage caused by the player should now be converted to [b]Nature damage[/b], causing extra damage to Armor and triggering Contagion.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause Red Chests to have a invisible area around them that would block incoming shots.
[*] Path of Kabeer's prices have [b]been increased[/b] to match other T4 Weapons (34.000 Bounty). We've also added a T3 version to the shop. 
[*] Start Mission Dialog now correctly displays to all Party members if it's a Special Mission or a Challenge Mode enabled Mission.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause the wrong VO line to be played when players delivered Orbs to Rifts.
[/list]


[h3]🔨 Tweaks & Balancing[/h3]

[list]
[*] Target Practice Dummies now display [b]Damage Numbers[/b] and a [b]DPS Counter[/b] at the Shooting Range.
[*] Increased[b] Firestarter’s Fire Damage Bonus[/b] from 40% to 60%.
[*] Added [b]2 new Feats[/b] to the "Rebel 2" Rank Chapter to introduce Grandpa Chronos’ Workshop.
[*] Increased material caps for all tiers—T4 Materials are now [b]capped at 999[/b], T3 and below are [b]capped at 99.999[/b].
[*] Removed Epic and Rare Catalysts from the Stranger's Shop
[*] Special Missions now reward more [b]T4 Materials[/b] for greater progression opportunities.
[*] Academy Arena Epic is now a Scavenge Mission
[/list]

[h3]🔨 Weapon Rebalance Batch #1[/h3]
Our goal with this batch of weapon tweaks is to have more viable weapon choices in the endgame, with different damage profiles and feel. We felt Marksman Rifles were exceptionally weak, and both Auto Rifles and Beam Rifles were also subpar.

[b]Weapon Types[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Auto Rifles[/b]: Base Damage increased from 28 to 32 (~14%)
[*] [b]Beam Rifles:[/b] Base Damage increased from 40 to 50 (25%)
[*] [b]Marksman Rifles: [/b]Base Damage increased from 33 to 41 (~24%)
[*] [b]Marksman Rifles:[/b] Precision Damage increased from 100% to 130% (30%)
[/list]

[b]Tier Adjustments[/b]

Several Legendary Weapons had different values between their T2, T3 and T4 versions. Most of them had a stronger T4 version. We've applied the T4 Stats to all other Tiers.

[b]T4 Weapon Bases[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Starduster:[/b] Increased Base Damage from 19 to 24.
[*] [b]Tangent:[/b] Increased Base Damage from 53 to 123, increased Fire Rate from 3 to 5, increased Precision Damage from 130% to 175%.
[*] [b]Derivative:[/b] Reduced Base Damage from 49 to 38 (30%), Increased Fire Rate from 7 to 12.6, Increased Magazine Size from 7 to 21.
[*] [b]Judgement:[/b]  Increased Base Damage from 15 to 19, Reduced Reload Time by 25%.
[*] [b]TwinkleTwinkle:[/b] Reduced Base Damage from 42 to 32. Increased Fire Rate from 12 to 20. Reduced Reload Time by 25%.
[*] [b]Bunny:[/b] Increased Fire Rate from 7 to 14. Increased Magazine Size from 7 to 12.
[*] [b]Segregationer:[/b] Increased Base Damage from 41 to 51, Reduced Fire Rate from 12 to 10.
[*] [b]Skull:[/b] Increased Base Damage from 27 to 56.
[*] [b]Ossein:[/b] Increased Condition Trigger from 10% to 30%.
[*] [b]Remembrance:[/b] Increased Base Damage from 19 to 22 (20%), reduced Fire Rate from 25 to 21.
[*] [b]Radian:[/b] Increased Base Damage from 29 to 64, reduced Fire Rate from 12 to 9.
[*] [b]Mediator:[/b] Increased Base Damage from 49 to 76 (70%), reduced Fire Rate from 7 to 5.
[*] [b]Omega Drive:[/b] Reduced Burst Size from 3 to 1, Reduced Critical Hit Damage from 154% to 110%, Increased Fire Rate from 2 to 3.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png[/img]

We’re committed to continuously improving Relic Hunters Legend with your valuable feedback. Jump into the action, test out these exciting changes, and let us know what you think on Discord or the Steam forums!

Thank you for your unwavering support, Hunters. See you in the Galaxy! 🌌

[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/bf9c473e4367bc9c04cc12702b3a4a3bab0bb90d.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Relic Hunters Legend: Roadmap to Launch 🚀
notes.content:
Hunters, we’re excited to unveil our Roadmap to Launch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/b24dd05d80ad8719948a69d5e7067aceb042cb6a.png[/img]

As we approach the finish line, we’re rolling out significant updates to make Relic Hunters Legend deeper, more rewarding, and packed with thrilling content. Here’s a detailed breakdown of what’s coming over the next few months:


[h1]December 2024: Grandpa Chronos’ Workshop & Challenge Mode[/h1]

December brings a massive update with new systems to elevate your build crafting and endgame farming experience.

[h2]🔸 Grandpa Chronos’ Workshop[/h2]

A brand-new feature where you can modify and upgrade your gear:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/21c403ea29e43fcf70486b7fe1cd3f1a09645663.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Add or change mods on items for more customization.
[*] Upgrade item tier to make them more powerful.
[*] Adjust item rarity to unlock better stats and bonuses.
[/list]

This is the ultimate tool for Hunters looking to perfect their builds!

[h2]🔸 Challenge Mode[/h2]

We’re introducing Challenge Mode to rework Endgame Farming and make it more flexible and rewarding:

[list]
[*] Activate Challenge Mode on any mission in the Broken Timeline to:
[*] Scale the mission to level 50 for maximum quality loot rolls.
[*] Farm T4 materials without being restricted by timegates.
[*] Face randomized challenges for unique gameplay experiences, keeping farming exciting and engaging.
[/list]

This system eliminates the need to grind lower-level missions for high-level rewards and ensures every run feels worthwhile.

[h1]January 2025: Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis (ADN) Rework[/h1]

January focuses on revamping the [b]Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis (ADN)[/b] to make it a true endgame highlight.

[h2]🔸 Key Changes:[/h2]

[h3]Shorter Cycle[/h3]

[list]
[*] ADN now resets every [b]3 days[/b] (instead of 7), letting you engage with it more frequently.
[/list]


[h3]Enhanced Regular ADN:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy Levels: Adjusted to 35–45 for better accessibility.
[*] 4-Player Co-op: Team up with friends to tackle missions together.
[*] Improved Rewards: Higher T4 material drops and other valuable resources.
[*] A great way to "train" for Greater ADN while still being rewarding.
[/list]

[h3]Greater ADN Redesign:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Solo or 2-Player Max[/b]: Greater ADN is now designed to be tackled solo or with a duo. We're focused on enhancing the experience for all players, whether you prefer to venture alone or as part of a team.
[*] [b]Pinnacle Activity[/b]: This is now the ultimate test of skill, requiring strong builds and careful execution.
[*] [b]New Rebel Rank Chapter[/b]: Players who complete all Greater ADN Missions will unlock exclusive bragging rewards like titles, banners, and more!
[/list]

[h3]Better Combat Balance:[/h3]

[*] [b]Regular ADN[/b]: Players now receive a resistance penalty  for added challenge.
[*] [b]Greater ADN[/b]: Resistance penalty is increased, making balancing offensive vs. defensive stats critical for success.

This rework aims to make ADN the cornerstone of the endgame, offering exciting challenges and satisfying rewards for dedicated players.

[h1]Q1 2025: Act 3 and More![/h1]

Between January and the full launch, we’ll focus on improving the gameplay by refining systems, fixing bugs and ensuring a smoother, more enjoyable experience. We’ll also be listening to any feedback and reactions from our community to the newly implemented features so we can continuously improving them.

The Launch 1.0 grand finale awaits early next year, and you can expect:

[h3]🔸 Act 3 Unveiled:[/h3]

[list]
[*] A brand-new chapter with new regions, enemies, and a thrilling conclusion to the story.
[/list]

-----------------------------


Stay tuned for exciting news about new ways to experience Relic Hunters Legend. 👀

Thank you, Hunters, for joining us on this journey. Your feedback and support have been invaluable as we prepare to launch the full Relic Hunters Legend experience. 

Let us know what feature you’re most excited about in the comments, and get ready for an exciting adventure ahead! 💬

notes.title: Patch 0.12 is here!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters!

Our patch 0.12 has arrived, now with all the new improvements and a few extra fixes based on feedback from our players. We’re committed to continuously enhancing the game, making adjustments that reflect what matters most to you. This update brings together everything you saw previously, along with some additional tweaks and quality-of-life changes we worked on right up until launch. We hope you enjoy the new patch and feel the impact of your feedback on the game!

Here’s what you can expect:

[h1] ⚡️ Super Affixes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/44f285aa53eef76541faad730d6c84e969f02b28.png[/img]

Starting at Tier 2, items now have a chance to upgrade their Regular Affixes into Super Affixes, offering 30-50% more power! The number of Super Affixes an item may have is limited by its Tier. A Tier 2 item may have one Super Affix, a Tier 3 may have two, and a Tier 4 may have three! 

These Super Affixes will have a Star Badge icon to highlight their increased power, and the Favorite icon has been changed to a heart to avoid confusion. Super Affixes have increased odds the higher the level of the Mission you’re playing, reaching its cap value at around Level 45. Also, Mass Recycle and Auto Recycle will now give the option to either skip or recycle items with Super Affixes.

[h1]🔄 Affix Changes[/h1] 

We’ve reduced the amount of Affixes Tier 4 items may have, as we thought it was just too much information (an Exotic T4 could have up to 8 Affixes!). We’ve also removed the randomness of the amount of Affixes. T4 will always have 2 Prefixes and 2 Suffixes, and an Exotic T4 will always have 3 Prefixes and 3 Suffixes.

To make it more likely to have better Affixes being rolled as Super, we’ve removed some lower-value Affixes like Ammo Drop Rate and Extra Ammo and increased the odds of more rare Affixes, such as All Skill Nodes and Multishot.

[i][b] **Please note that your existing items will not be affected by this change, as these updates apply only to new items.**[/b][/i]

[h1]📦 Storage Space Increase[/h1]

We’ve heard your feedback and increased the Storage Size for all players to 200! Extra Storage Space rewards have been removed to simplify the system.

[h1]💥 Combo Rework[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/c4ffb929ccb5cacf64ac071cccbb5cda4ca1ac7f.gif[/img]

The Combo system is getting a major overhaul! Previously, you needed multiple Hunters to pull off Combos, but now, every Hunter can Prime and Detonate Combos solo, making combat faster and more dynamic.

Here’s how the new Combo system works:

- [b]Combo Priming[/b]: Any Hunter can now Prime enemies by attacking.
- [b]Combo Detonation[/b]: After Priming, you can Detonate the Combo with a Detonation Skill. The Detonation no longer causes area damage but instead focuses on the enemies hit.

[b]New Combo Damage Types[/b]: Detonation damage now depends on the Hunter you’re playing:
  - [b]Pinkyy[/b]: Impact Damage
  - [b]Jimmy[/b]: Frag Damage
  - [b]Raff[/b]: Magnetic Damage
  - [b]Ace[/b]: Fire Damage
  - [b]Panzer[/b]: Fire Damage
  - [b]Seven[/b]: Water Damage

This means you can now take advantage of damage bonuses based on your Hunter’s Detonation type! For instance, if you’re playing Seven, Water Damage bonuses will now apply to your Combo Detonations. This change makes Combos more flexible and rewarding for different builds!

[h1]🏆 New Steam Achievements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/95e4614e7c4ab4a1a59a69211d85c09733dd44fd.png[/img]

We’ve added 18 new Steam Achievements! They are retroactive, meaning you don’t need to replay content to unlock them, except for two of these new Achievements that will only be unlockable with the 1.0 release.

[h1]🔧Small Tweaks & Fixes [/h1]

[list]
[*] Revive Countdown no longer freezes when opening UI windows.
[*] Damage Numbers now have a new Icon for Critical Hits.
[*] Damage Numbers are now displayed in a more orderly fashion to improve readability.
[*] DeathnatorX lines were updated to reflect the changes made to Combos.
[*] DeathnatorX now explains how Break Bar works.
[*] We’ve reduced the amount of Skill Duration and Skill Range for all Affixes by roughly 20%.
[*] Complete Mission Co-op Quests have been removed.
[*] Complete Help Others Feats in Rebel Chapters have been replaced by “Complete Missions”.
[*] A “Kind Stranger” Chapter no longer invisible in Offline mode, and its feats are no longer autocompleted.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause Gamepad Cursor to be slower than it should be in multiple screens.
[*] Hard and Epic Exploration Missions now have their Rewards displayed in their Mission Tooltips.
[*] Break Bar debuff is now correctly removed when the enemy leaves the Break State.
[*] Fixed Weapon Range Affixes.
[*] Fixed “Avatar” and “Frame” Augmentation Affixes, they were granting 30% resistances instead of 50%.
[*] Ducan Machinegunner and Turlek Machinegunner have had their VFXs fixed and it no longer looks like the shots are going through covers. 
[*] Safety Protest Officer’s Weapon has been replaced by the Riot Control.
[/list]

[h1]🙏 Thank You![/h1]

This patch was built on your feedback, and we couldn’t have done it without your incredible support. We’re continuing to make improvements and address feedback from the community on both Steam and in our Discord discussions. If you haven’t already, join us on [url=discord.gg/relichunters]Discord[/url] at to share your thoughts and be part of our community!

Thank you, Hunters! Patch 0.12 is live, so jump in and enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 0.11 is Here – 25% Discount in Celebration of Our Early Access Anniversary
notes.content:
Hunters, we’ve reached an incredible milestone:[b] 1 Year of Early Access for Relic Hunters Legend![/b] To celebrate, we’re offering a [b]25% discount [/b]on the game until [b]October 5th. [/b]

This is the perfect time to jump in and experience the exciting new features in Patch 0.11 as we gear up for our 1.0 launch.

[h1]What’s New in Patch 0.11?[/h1]

[h2]Removal of Online Requirements[/h2]

Relic Hunters Legend will no longer be an online-only game. Now, you can choose to [b]play solo offline[/b] or[b] engage with friends in online multiplaye[/b]r. Both options are available under the same account, so you no longer need to level up separate accounts for offline or online.

To ensure your progress is maintained, we’ve introduced progress migration from the online servers to your local devices. Your progress will be downloaded the first time you log in after the update, and it will sync via Steam Cloud Save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/2b110cc10a1089f614beb98865d2f73528aa5fdd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Progress Migration Details:[/h3]

When you first login after the patch, your account will automatically sync from the Live Servers and save your progress locally on your PC.

🛑 [b]Important:[/b] You will have until [b]January 3rd, 2025[/b] to [b]migrate your account progress[/b]. After this date, we will deactivate the AWS server holding your data, and you will no longer be able to recover your online progress. Make sure to log in and complete the migration before the deadline!

If you have any issues with your migration, please contact us at [b]support@roguesnail.com[/b].

[h2]Save Slots[/h2]

We’re introducing [b]three new Save Slots[/b], allowing you to have multiple accounts. Your old Online and Offline accounts will remain intact, so you’ll be able to have up to [b]five different accounts[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/1de2b54a7539fdb26138b6aee8ce1cf628dd2791.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fashion Credits[/h2]

We’ve revamped the system for unlocking cosmetics! Your existing currencies (Time Crystals and Shop Tokens) will automatically convert into the new [b]Fashion Credits[/b]. All cosmetics can now be purchased with these credits, and the Stranger Shop still accepts Kindness.

Your fashion credit count should be the sum of the tokens and crystals you had in your account multiplied by 10!

The following activities will grant you Fashion Credits:
[list]
[*] Defeating Champion enemies
[*] Final Round rewards from Payload, Scavenge, Rift Missions
[*] Defense and Distraction Chest rewards
[*] Special Missions
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/a7d6ffcebef7691f45fc5f1d204c79ed15662e86.jpg[/img]

[h2]Help Others Review System[/h2]

We’ve redesigned the Help Others Review System to reward players who stick together during missions. You’ll now receive a Buff for staying close to your teammates, leading to extra Kindness rewards at the end of the mission. We’ve also removed the Kindness Weekly Cap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/25e106ba1e5a352d9c18607014d9904175572eb6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Content and Skill Changes[/h2]

We’ve added [b]new weapon variants[/b] for Ducan Troopers and Turlek Boomers, along with several [b]skill changes[/b] to improve solo play for characters like [b]Pinkyy, Raff, and Ace[/b].

[h3]#### Skill Changes [/h3]

Skill Range and Skill Duration stats are now additive instead of multiplicative. We've adjusted some Skill Nodes to be more useful when playing solo: 

[b]Pinkyy: [/b]
[list]
[*] "I've Got Your Back" now adds Overarmor to herself and not just to allies. Skill Node description has been adjusted to reflect this change. 
[/list]

[b]Raff: [/b]
[list]
[*] "Wrench" now gives Overshield to Raff even if no allies are hit by it. Skill Node description has been adjusted to reflect this change. 
[*] "Field Repairs" text has also been adjusted. 
[*] "Keytar Blast" now gives Overshields to Raff, not just to allies. Skill Node description has been adjusted. 
[*] "Soothing Riffs" now gives a Self Heal to Raff when using "Keytar Blast." Skill Node description has been adjusted. 
[*] "I Got You" has been redesigned. It now causes "Soundscape" to grant Damage Reduction to Raff and nearby allies. 
[/list]

[b]Ace: [/b]
[list]
[*] "Backstab" text has been fixed to reflect it grants extra Critical Hit Chance instead of Critical Hit Damage. It now applies this bonus if the target is affected by a Lure Ability (like Ace's "Holo-Sandwich"). 
[*] "Sneaky" has been redesigned. It now grants extra Movement Speed when there are no enemies nearby.
[/list]

[h2]Player Trading System[/h2]

We’ve temporarily disabled the Player Trading System as we rework the function in this new environment. Stay tuned for future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png[/img]

We want to take a moment to sincerely thank all our players for believing in Relic Hunters Legend and supporting us through this journey. Your dedication has fueled our passion and driven us to continue improving and evolving the game. Special thanks to everyone who participated in our Beta Test last week – your feedback was incredibly helpful!

Come celebrate with us and enjoy the [b]25% discount[/b] to dive into the game to experience these new changes firsthand. We hope everyone enjoys the updates, and we can’t thank you enough for your continued support. Let’s make the next year of Relic Hunters Legend even more legendary together!

Cheers,
The Rogue Snail Team

notes.title: Join Us for a Relic Hunters Legend Progress Migration Beta Test on September 16!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

We’re here to ask for your help as we prepare for the release of the next patch of Relic Hunters Legend. From September 16 to 18, we’ll be conducting a Beta Test that focuses on one of the most crucial changes in the game: [b]the transfer of player progress from our online servers to local devices[/b]. We also want to test the Cosmetics revamp and Help Others related features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/1de2b54a7539fdb26138b6aee8ce1cf628dd2791.jpg[/img]

This will be a technical test, and we’re counting on our dedicated Early Access players to join us in making sure everything works smoothly. Your help will ensure that everyone’s hard-earned progress is safely transferred as we transition to offline and optional co-op modes.

Please note, any progress made during this technical beta [b]will not be transferred to the regular version of the game.[/b] You will be able to play as you want, but[b] progression will not carry over.[/b]

Once Patch 0.11 is released, the final Account Migration will happen automatically once you log into the game.

As a small indie team, we’ve faced numerous challenges this year. Every decision and change we’ve made has been with our community in mind, but we simply don’t have the resources to test everything on our own. That’s why we need our most committed Hunters to step up and help us make sure these crucial features function as intended.

[h3]Your participation in this Technical Beta Test will help us ensure that:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Player progress is transferred correctly from servers to local storage.
[*] The new system is stable and free from bugs or glitches.
[*] Any issues are identified early so we can fix them before the final release.
[/list]

[h3]What You’ll Be Testing:[/h3]

This test will focus specifically on the[b] progression migration feature[/b]. When you log in during the Beta, your online progress will be transferred to your local device. From there, you can play offline or in co-op, without the need for servers.

[h3]We’ll need your feedback on the process:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Did your progress transfer successfully?
[*] Did you experience any bugs or errors during the migration?
[*] Are there any glitches or issues in the new system?

[h1]How to Get Involved 💻[/h1]

[/list]

[h1]Your Support Makes a Difference 💜[/h1]

We’re a small studio with big dreams, and your support helps us get closer to realizing them. We’ve worked tirelessly to keep Relic Hunters Legend alive and thriving, despite the challenges we’ve faced. Your involvement in this Beta Test will not only ensure a smoother final release but will also help us continue creating the best experience possible for all players.

[h1]Thank You in Advance 🙏[/h1]

Every bit of feedback counts. We’re incredibly grateful for our community and appreciate the time and effort you’ll put into helping us with this test. Together, we can make Relic Hunters Legend the game it was always meant to be!

Mark your calendars for [b]September 16[/b] and join us on [url=discord.gg/relichunters]Discord[/url] for more details. Let’s make this test a success and bring Relic Hunters Legend closer to its final launch!

See you soon, Hunters!  
[i]— The Rogue Snail Team[/i]

notes.title: Unveiling the Future of Relic Hunters Legend: Major Changes and New Horizons
notes.content:
Dear Hunters,

We have important updates and changes to share with you regarding Relic Hunters Legend, our beloved shooter-looter RPG. 

As you may recall from our previous announcement in June, we no longer have the support of a publisher, and we needed to find a sustainable way to keep the game alive for a longer time. After careful consideration, we have decided to implement some major changes to the game:


[h1]Removal of Online Requirements[/h1]


Relic Hunters Legend will [b]no longer be an online-only game[/b]. You can now choose to play solo or engage with friends in an online multiplayer experience. 

During these past months, we've worked diligently to ensure that all Early Access players’ progress in the online version is transferred. As the cloud servers are being shut down, your progress will be downloaded to your devices the first time you log in after the 0.11 update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/31dbc24b6e5d1d49e634c7d71ef9a758eb94a83e.jpg[/img]

[b]The game will now feature save slots[/b]. Each "account" will function as a separate save. Players can create up to three new accounts, including their existing ones that will be migrated. If you already had an online account, after downloading the final patch and completing the migration, you will still have three new slots.

The folder containing your progress will sync via Steam Cloud Save, just as offline progress syncs today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/2b110cc10a1089f614beb98865d2f73528aa5fdd.jpg[/img]

Also, all accounts will be able to play online or offline by choosing to enable or disable online multiplayer before logging into their game. This means that the account progress you choose will be consistent, whether you want to play in single-player mode or online multiplayer.

This is the most significant change we've made so far, and we are already implementing it in our Early Access to ensure a smooth transition for all players.

[h2]Player Trading System[/h2]

Since the current trading system depended on our dedicated online servers, it needs to be reworked to function in a peer-to-peer environment. Therefore, it has been temporarily disabled.

[h2]Changes on the Help Others feature[/h2]

Some features of the Help Others system functioned due to being interconnected with dedicated online servers. With these servers being shut down, we’ll have to remove the ability to Review other players who joined the game via Help Others. We’re exploring ways to provide automatic reviews based on how players behaved in their matches.

[h1]Relic Hunters Legend Will No Longer Be F2P at 1.0 Launch[/h1]

You know how the gaming industry has been changing a lot lately, and new challenges have been presented to various development studios - ours is no exception. With all these challenges in hand, we needed to think of a monetization plan for the game that would be fair to our players and sustainable for us as an independent studio.

With limited resources, both financial and human, we couldn't keep the promise we made in our Kickstarter to make Relic Hunters Legend free-to-play. We didn't want to implement predatory monetization features that would make players spend a lot of time, effort, and money to progress in the game. We want to respect your time and money and provide a complete and engaging content experience. We have to focus our limited resources into making the game as fun as possible, and we just can’t spare the effort that goes into monetization.

So now we’ll r[b]emove all monetization aspects[/b] from the game. The 1.0 launch will be a [b]fully premium game, priced at $20 at final launch[/b]. There will be no in-game transactions or other in-game purchases—just a one-time purchase.

Founders and backers who supported us earlier and were promised monetization benefits will receive a new currency at the final launch that we've created called [i]"Fashion Credit,"[/i] equivalent to the value of the package they purchased. This currency will also be earned by completing missions and it’ll drop from enemies during your adventures - so everyone will be able to buy all cosmetics in the game.

[h1]New Patch 0.11 Content[/h1]

We have worked tirelessly over the past few months to ensure a more refined gameplay experience. We've fixed various errors, authentication issues, and bugs, many of which were reported by our community - and we’re immensely grateful for all the feedback and reports! This has greatly helped us improve the experience with Relic Hunters Legend and today, the game is more stable and performs much better.

Some of these changes that are already included in the future patch are:

[h2]New Save Slots feature and Online Data Migration [/h2]

[list]
[*] Your progress will be downloaded directly to your device the first time you log in after the update. 
[*] You’ll have 5 save slots - two with your migrated accounts and three empty spots for you to use as you wish.
[/list]

[h2]Content[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added different weapon variants for each region for Ducan Troopers and Turlek Boomers.
[/list]

[h2]Skill Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Skill Range and Skill Duration stats are now additive instead of multiplicative.
[/list]

We've adjusted some Skill Nodes to be more useful when playing solo:

[h3][b]Pinkyy:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] "I've Got Your Back" now adds Overarmor to herself and not just to allies. Skill Node description has been adjusted to reflect this change.
[/list]

[h3][b]Raff:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] "Wrench" now gives Overshield to Raff even if no allies are hit by it. Skill Node description has been adjusted to reflect this change. "Field Repairs" text has also been adjusted.
[*] "Keytar Blast" now gives Overshields to Raff, not just to allies. Skill Node description has been adjusted.
[*] "Soothing Riffs" now gives a Self Heal to Raff when using "Keytar Blast." Skill Node description has been adjusted.
[*] "I Got You" has been redesigned. It now causes "Soundscape" to grant Damage Reduction to Raff and nearby allies.
[/list]

[h3][b]Ace:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] "Backstab" text has been fixed to reflect it grants extra Critical Hit Chance instead of Critical Hit Damage. It now applies this bonus if the target is affected by a Lure Ability (like Ace's "Holo-Sandwich").
[*] "Sneaky" has been redesigned. It now grants extra Movement Speed when there are no enemies nearby.
[/list]

[h1]Update 0.11 Beta Test[/h1]

To ensure that there are no errors during the final migration of your accounts, we plan to conduct a beta test for this new feature before releasing update 0.11. We’ll provide more details and dates for this test soon.

We count on your support to ensure that everyone has a smooth and seamless experience with these significant changes we’re making to the game. If you have any interest or questions about this, keep an eye here on Steam or join our Discord to speak directly with the developers!


[h1]Road to Launch 1.0[/h1]

Our final release is approaching and you can expect the conclusion of our Relic Hunters' adventure with the arrival of the final Act! In this release, you will see:

[list]
[*] [b]Main Campaign Act 3[/b]: Concluding the game's main story.
[*] [b]A New Region with more missions[/b]
[*] [b]New Rebel Rank Chapters[/b]
[*] [b]Cosmetics Unlocking Revamp[/b]
[*] [b]Increased Storage Space[/b]
[*] [b]New Steam Achievements[/b]
[/list]

Despite the challenges we've faced, we believe in our project and hope players will enjoy the final result. The game will feature approximately [b]30 hours of story campaign[/b] and offer over [b]200 hours of gameplay for those aiming for full completion[/b]. 

Our journey so far has been filled with highs and lows, and the game had a somewhat turbulent start. We are aware that removing Free-to-Play isn't what we envisioned during our Kickstarter campaign - we've faced the reality of our situation, making tough decisions that we believe will result in the best possible version of the game for both our current players and those yet to come.

We are incredibly grateful for all the support the community has given to Relic Hunters Legend over the years, from the beginning of our Kickstarter to the more challenging early days of Early Access. We have fixed a LOT of issues, listened to all of your feedback, and we believe that 1.0 is a really good game that we’re proud of. The challenge will be to attract new players and hopefully get our Reviews back up to a good level - if that happens, we can continue working on our dream game and growing the Relic Hunters universe!

—

[h1]Thank you for all your support throughout these years![/h1]

We want to express our deepest gratitude to you, our community. Without your support, we wouldn't even be here. We've been developing this game for a long time, pouring our hearts, sweat, tears, and effort into making the best game we can.

We've faced numerous challenges along this journey, and at many points we thought our community could give up on us - but you never did. Thank you for being with us every step of the way.

We really hope you enjoy 1.0 and the conclusion of the story of Seven, the Time Traveller. Your passion and dedication means the world to us, and we can't wait for you to experience everything we've created.

Thank you,
[i]The Rogue Snail Team[/i]

notes.title: New Update 0.10 - Introducing the Offline Mode and More!
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!

Today we bring you some exciting news. We have carefully listened to all the feedback, suggestions, and complaints you have shared with us during these months of Early Access and we have made improvements to the Relic Hunters Legend experience.

What to expect from the 0.10 update:

[h1]Offline Mode[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/b21101142be5bef0aab2b3cf793a9aa373a580fb.gif[/img]

You can now play Relic Hunters Legend with no internet connection! This offline mode is completely single-player, and you can access it from the login screen.

This way, you’ll have two saves: one online, where your progress will be stored on our servers, and another offline which will be saved locally on your PC. These saves [b]do not interact directly with each other[/b], so your online progress [b]will not be transferred[/b] to the offline mode and vice versa.

This feature was developed after hearing a lot of your feedback and understanding that not all players who want to play Relic Hunters Legend have access to a good internet connection or would like to play it during a trip in airplane mode.

Now you can enjoy this galactic adventure wherever you are!

[h1]No More “Forced Single-Player”![/h1]

We have changed some aspects of the game's story after listening to your feedback, and now there will be [b]no more so-called "forced single-player."[/b] Play the story when you want without needing to complete it to continue progressing in the game.

The initial story experience has also been revised, reducing its length and making it simpler and faster to go through. Another change is in the balance of the early chapters of the Rebel Rank. Now, there will be independent story and gameplay chapters, allowing you to play without worrying about story progression.

[h1]New Way to Unlock Hunters![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/8f62feb1c6c89ddc80669f00e180e45c647619fd.gif[/img]

From now on, unlocking Hunters has become easier: as you level up your Rebel Rank, you’ll receive Hunter Tokens that can be used to unlock the characters you desire. With this change, story quests will no longer be tied to unlocking characters.

[h1]New Hunter Selection Screen![/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/b2ea53930662bdf4fabafbd3d9018c69564893dd.gif[/img]

We have made several improvements to the character selection screen, making it simpler to understand and visually more appealing.


[h1]Stranger's Shop and Kindness changes[/h1]

We've revamped the way you obtain Kindness Currency and the essential Ascendant Keys. Now, you can purchase both at the Enigma Store!

[list]
[*] Kindness Currency can be bought with Stars that you acquire by playing missions and quests within the game. 
[*] The Ascendant Keys will be sold using Kindness.
[/list]

But wait, there’s more! The Stranger’s Shop is now open every single day of the week. No more waiting for specific days – you can pop in whenever it suits you. Enjoy the ultimate convenience and a smoother gaming experience!

[h1]New Adventures Introducing Endgame Content[/h1]

We’ll have new adventures that will introduce the endgame systems with legendary material rewards.

We implemented this feature to make it easier for all players who reach this stage of the game to understand, a topic that has been raised frequently during these months.

We've also added 2 new Adventures that will introduce players to the Chaos and Broken Eras.

Additionally, we redesign the Treasure Maps and Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis Adventures to have more gameplay-centric Quests to help introduce both features.

[h1]Break Status changes[/h1]

Enemies with the BREAK status are now treated as Frozen, Silenced, and Stunned. This means any skills or character stats that have effects on Frozen, Silenced, or Stunned enemies (like increased damage) will also apply to enemies with the BREAK status.

[h1]Performance Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h1]

We’ve reduced the overall memory usage by reconfiguring our Asset Bundles and texture sizes.

We’ve also made several bug fixes, including Transfering and Enhancing items now correctly update the Gear Score.

===

We appreciate all the feedback regarding Legend and hope you enjoy these changes.

We want to keep hearing your feedback on these and other game-related issues - Join our Official Discord and share what you think we should work on next!

Cheers,
The Rogue Snail Team
