notes.title: New Hunter: Panzer! Relic Hunters Legend
notes.content:
Hey Hunters!

Today, we're thrilled to introduce the latest addition to the lineup of hunters – say hello to Panzer, our favorite little pyro-maniac.

Panzer is Jimmy’s little sister, and both of them were adopted by a group of anti-Ducan rebels. The siblings didn't take too long to demonstrate a spectacular aptitude for ruining the day for the Ducans! However, Panzer doesn’t have a strong desire to be part of the rebellion and relic hunting missions, but she can be swayed by some Chocolate Fudge Balls.

[h2]Skill Overview[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/bc7886e4ae4874713011a4a698bda3e9b87cb555.gif[/img]

[h3]Panzer’s abilities include:[/h3]

●[b]Can’t Catch Me[/b] –Panzer jumps into the air and bounces off an enemy’s head for greater battlefield mobility.
●[b]Headbutt[/b] – Panzer headbutts right into the enemy, creating an impact area that damages and pushes other enemies. This skill can detonate other Hunters’ combos for maximum damage.
●[b]Growl[/b] – Panzer unleashes a growl that stuns all enemies near her for 3 seconds.
●[b]Bite[/b] – Panzer chomps an enemy 3 consecutive times for repeated damage.
●[b]Fire Frenzy[/b] – Panzer enters her rage mode, dealing more weapon and skill damage at the cost of a lowered resistance. During this mode, all her skills release a Fire Shockwave every time they hit an enemy.
●[b]Burn Burn Burn[/b] - Panzer grabs her trusty Flamethrower, causing a burning mayhem Ultimate. She gains +20% Movement Speed, +30% Bonus Fire Damage, and is immune to Freeze, Stun, and SIlence. Flamethrower deals constant 100 Fire Damage.
To unlock Panzer, make sure you update Relic Hunters Legend to the newest update - 0.9.0 and complete Panzer’s Friendship Adventure “Wildlife Show”! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f5754eafa0577534cc3d54a9b7f4e3ca0ef9d364.gif[/img]

Now is a great time for players to jump into the game’s Early Access and master all of the Hunters’ abilities. From March 14 through March 21, Relic Hunters Legend is 33% off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/bf9ad0f0406e5d6341ee3a9336087a791e11a640.png[/img]

[h2]Treasure Maps[/h2]

Also new to Patch 0.9.0 is the introduction to the Treasure Maps System. This is a new endgame feature that centers around the discovery and exploration of special items known as "Treasure Maps". These consumable items will unveil randomized mini-exploration missions within your Navigation System.
Adventures Await
Each mission Treasure Map is designed to offer unique challenges, making each Mission feel different from the others. These missions are home to incredibly important and rewarding Treasure Chests, powerful Champions, and abundant farming opportunities, promising an unparalleled adventure for players to immerse themselves in.
Unlock the Rewards


The Treasure Chests, featured in each Treasure Map, house coveted prizes such as Relic fragments and Legendary equipment. However, unlike other chests in Relic Hunters Legend, these Treasure Chests will require special keys for unlocking. These keys can be enhanced to increase the likelihood of acquiring superior loot, with higher-tier keys promising even greater rewards!

[h2]Introducing The Cartographers[/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f15c2d7a486a9e0fb5b9327e555b5e936aa3ae8e.png[/img]
As part of the Treasure Map System, we’re pleased to unveil a new faction: The Cartographers! These astute allies play a pivotal role in guiding and supporting players throughout their treasure hunting journey. Make sure to check The Cartographers’ shop to embark on their quests, and check their goods for sale.


To see what else is in the new Patch 0.9.0 you can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/4101162602043759654]here[/url] and see all the new Relics, Gear, Weapons, bug fixes, and more being added to Relic Hunters Legend!

Until next time! Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Relic Hunters Legend - Patch Notes for 0.9.0
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

We're happy to announce the first big update to our Early Access! This release introduces a new Hunter, Panzer! It also includes a new endgame activity called "Treasure Maps" and new Relics, Weapons, Gear, Rebel Rank Chapters, and more!

Thank you for supporting us! This update has been shaped by community feedback - if you want to join the party, head over to our Discord!

Discord: https://discord.gg/relichunters 

Happy hunting!


Patch Notes- March 14th
=======================

[b]What’s New: [/b]

●New Hunter: Panzer
●Treasure Maps
●New NPC where players can exchange lower-end materials for high-end materials
●Special Missions reworked to be more frequent and give much better rewards
●10 New Relics
●3 New Unique Weapons
●4 New Unique Gear
●16 new Legendary Gear
●4 New Rebel Rank Chapters
      ○The Raging Mascot 1,2, and 3
      ○Relic Hunter 2
      ○Legendary Gear 3
      ○Legendary Weapons 3

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

●Projectile Weapons will now work when shot from inside the Ducan Fanatic’s Barrier
●Weapons with override slot are no longer causing slots to become empty when players log in
●The Scanner and the Obsidian Cat Relics will now properly scale as their level increases
●Ace, Raff, and Pinkyy no longer become softlocked when being silenced while charging their Charge Skills
●Kami Nari and Ducan Siren are no longer breaking the "Cannot be Silenced" and "Cannot be Stunned" affixes.
●Consuming more than one consumable results now correctly adds the proper experience points (there was a desync between client and server)
●Shotguns Weapon Tooltips are now displaying Shot Amount info 
●The "collect gear/weapons" objectives now work if you've got auto-recycle on
●Gear Score will now recalculate when you Transfer enhancement levels between different items
●Ace can now trigger portals when airborne during his Ultimate.
●Buff/Debuff displays no longer fail to show texts and duration when the game is in Korean or Chinese languages
●Skipping Bartender's dialogue no longer causes a loss of functionality
●Enemies are now properly interrupted when defeated or when crowd controlled.
●Ace's accessory positioning is now in the proper place

notes.title: Thank You for Testing Relic Hunters Legend Public Test Server
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We want to extend a massive thank you to all the players who participated in the recent Public Test Server for Relic Hunters Legend and provided invaluable feedback on our new feature, Treasure Maps. Your dedication and enthusiasm have been instrumental in helping us shape the future of the game, and we are incredibly grateful for your support.

[h1]Importance of Player Feedback[/h1]

The Public Test Server ran for 10 days, during which time players had the opportunity to thoroughly explore and test the new Treasure Maps feature.

We got a lot of new feedback and it has provided us with invaluable insights into the gameplay experience and has empowered us to make informed decisions about the future of Relic Hunters Legend. Your input on the new feature, as well as the overall game experience, is instrumental in helping us refine and enhance the game for all players.

[h1]Future Updates and Improvements[/h1]

We’re now in the process of gathering and analyzing all the feedback received during the Public Test Server. Your comments, suggestions, and bug reports will directly contribute to the development of our next update, which will aim to address any issues, enhance gameplay mechanics, and further enrich the Treasure Maps feature based on your input.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png[/img]

Once again, we extend our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you for your active participation and dedication during the Public Test Server. Your passion for the game and your commitment to providing constructive feedback are truly appreciated, and we are thrilled to have such an amazing community supporting Relic Hunters Legend.

Stay tuned for updates on the upcoming improvements and new content, as we continue to work tirelessly to deliver an even more immersive and enjoyable gaming experience for all of our players.

Thank you for being an essential part of the Relic Hunters Legend journey!

notes.title: Unveiling the Treasure Maps: Explore a New Adventure in Relic Hunters Legend!
notes.content:
Hi Hunters,

Hope you’re having a great time playing on our Public Test Server and discovering the mysteries and rewards behind the new feature: The Treasure Maps.

We’ve introduced a new feature that is already available for testing in our Public Test Server (PTS) – the Treasure Map System! As we talked about in our previous[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/7155726611375692945] Steam Post[/url], we embarked on this exciting phase and we would like to extend a warm invitation to our community to join us in this exclusive testing opportunity, which will be open until February 26th at 3 PM UTC. 

[h1]Discover the Treasure Map System[/h1]

The Treasure Map System is a new endgame feature that centers around the discovery and exploration of special items known as "Treasure Maps". These consumable items will unveil randomized mini-exploration missions within your Navigation System.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/83a4978dc9dd9af8c2b4711bd3e9aa3a935e1bca.gif[/img]

[h1]Adventures Await[/h1]

Each mission Treasure Map is designed to offer unique challenges, making each Mission feel different from the others. These missions are home to incredibly important and rewarding Treasure Chests, powerful Champions, and abundant farming opportunities, promising an unparalleled adventure for players to immerse themselves in.

[h1]Unlock the Rewards[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/5c50af03ca224ee6605767d5174526e01642f9ee.gif[/img]

The Treasure Chests featured in each Treasure Map, house coveted prizes such as relic fragments and rare equipment. However, unlike other chests in Relic Hunters Legend, these Treasure Chests will require special keys for unlocking. These keys can be enhanced to increase the likelihood of acquiring superior loot, with higher-tier keys promising even greater rewards.

[h1]Introducing The Cartographers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f15c2d7a486a9e0fb5b9327e555b5e936aa3ae8e.png[/img]

As part of the Treasure Map System, we’re pleased to unveil a new faction: The Cartographers! These astute allies play a pivotal role in guiding and supporting players throughout their treasure hunting journey. Make sure to check The Cartographers’ shop to embark on their quests, and check their goods for sale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/cd1ad956bc54d45a786426ce03ccd26f5826ed07.png[/img]
We’re eagerly anticipating the invaluable feedback from our community during the upcoming PTS. Your participation and insights will be instrumental in shaping the future of Relic Hunters Legend, and we want to hear your thoughts and experiences with the Treasure Maps.

We encourage all willing players to partake in this testing phase, as your feedback will be crucial in refining and perfecting our game. Together, let's embark on this adventure and work towards creating an even more immersive and rewarding experience for all players.

Thank you for your ongoing support, and we look forward to embarking on this journey with you on the Public Test Server!

Happy Hunting!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/633b6203fab28b784c375f1069d39070b0ba7afb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Join the Relic Hunters Legend Public Test Server!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the launch of the Public Test Server (PTS) for Relic Hunters Legend! This PTS presents an exciting opportunity for our dedicated community to get an exclusive first look at the new features we've been developing.

From the beginning of our Early Access, we've been listening to all the suggestions and feedback you've brought. We've fixed several features and bugs, but we know plenty must be done to deliver the best possible experience for you.

We appreciate all the love and support that our community has been giving us all this time and we hope you continue with us on this journey.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/bb5a80c2b9db45b09e1dabc8d85df9eec519525f.png[/img]

The primary goal of this PTS is to gather valuable feedback from our community. This feedback will be instrumental in refining and enhancing the game, ensuring that it meets the expectations and desires of our players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/83a4978dc9dd9af8c2b4711bd3e9aa3a935e1bca.gif[/img]

Therefore, before releasing the Treasure Maps in a new, more robust, and complex update, we create the Public Test Server so that all players who are interested in helping us improve Relic Hunters Legend can have an advanced look at this new feature, which includes various new maps, a new faction, new items, some rebalancing and changes that were previously discussed with the community.

In this test server, your accounts will be leveled up to be able to play the End Game. This way, you can test all the new features we have implemented in the game without the need to level up a character again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e266427f894c16c12dd5898cfecc97d771527d99.png[/img]

This also means that progress will not be saved and will not transfer to the normal server. As we mentioned, the purpose of this server is to gather as much feedback as possible to improve Legend.

We've been working on this feature for the past few months and have fixed a large portion of the bugs and errors that you may encounter, but we want your help to further refine the game and carefully listen to your needs and suggestions to make the necessary changes before the new build, which will have a lot more content for you to check out.

[h2]Duration[/h2]

The PTS will run for 10 days, during which participants will have the chance to explore the new features and provide their input thoroughly.

[b]Start Date: February 16th at 1 PM UTC
End Date: February 26th at 3 PM UTC[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/940377c49e0c36155ecdc8241ee2ffe87fdb2499.png[/img]

To participate in this exclusive testing phase, simply enter the password below on Steam to access this version of Relic Hunters Legend. We encourage all willing players to join us in this endeavor and help us identify any errors, areas for improvement, or elements that could be enhanced.

[h3][b]Password: publictest022024[/b][/h3]

Here is a quick tutorial to activate the PTS:

Go to your Library and find Relic Hunters Legend

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/6362ac4ff2316a80bd1392b6aba1bb7e3a0f994d.png[/img]


Click with the right bottom of the game and select “Properties”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/0cce5a1fdb2507a85a701cf5f48a26eea1f3e7b8.png[/img]

Go to “Betas” and on “Private Betas” copy and paste the password.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e79427c525a2a36637f6ffa4ed6a89c31a904753.png[/img]

Then on “Beta Participation” select the Public Test Server and done!

Your contributions during this PTS will play a crucial role in shaping the final release of Relic Hunters Legend, which will feature even more exciting content and improvements based on the feedback received.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/634190bc53474fcb8de531430b7ddf6be081dced.png[/img]

In addition to the Treasure Maps endgame system and a lot of new items, we are also making experimental changes to the balance of the Hunters. 

In a nutshell, we are trying to bring all Hunters to the same power level as Raff, while making sure that Raff is more effective as a support character and a bit less effective as a raw damage dealer. 

We are also making an attempt at bringing guns back to the endgame meta with significant Weapon Damage buffs across the board. This should hopefully also enable some weapon-centric builds from Hunters such as Jimmy or Ace to become more viable.

We hope that with the new changes and the new items (such as Pinkyy’s “Brawler’s Rags”, which enables her “Low-Life” playstyle like never before) you will have a much more interesting and diverse meta instead of just “Raff goes brrrrrrr”.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] For the PTS, all accounts will start at Rebel Rank 9 with all Hunters unlocked at level 25 with full Rare+15 gear sets
[*] New activity: Treasure Maps
[*] Over 100 new level bases for the randomly-generated Treasure Map missions, including some new tilesets and assets
[*] New Faction: Cartographers (meet them at the End of Time)
[*] New Tutorial for Treasure Maps
[*] New Item Type: Treasure Maps can drop from all Hard and Epic difficulty activities
[*] New Item Type: Treasure Keys with different rarity tiers (Old, Curious, Mystical, and Ascendant)
[*] New Material: Cartographer’s Shards (used to enhance Keys and to purchase goods from the Cartographers Faction NPC vendor)
[*] New “Treasure Hunter I” and “Treasure Hunter II” Rebel Rank Chapters and Feats
[*] New Item Type: Unique Weapons
[*] Dozens of new items (see full list below)
[/list]

notes.title: Relic Hunters Legend - Patch Notes for 0.8.9
notes.content:

Hey Hunters,

This release focuses on elevating your daily adventures with revamped Exploration Daily Goals where players will get scored for defeating enemies, collecting chests, and looting resource nodes. These patches are our start in that direction, with more updates in the pipeline! You can read more about the State of the Game here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/633080/announcements/detail/3886108111272231369?snr=2___]https://steamcommunity.com/games/633080/announcements/[/url]

notes.title: State of the Game and Future Development
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

Welcome to our very first "State of the Game" post! My name is Mark, and I'm the Game Director for Relic Hunters Legend here at Rogue Snail.

It's been a wild ride since launch, and we are super grateful for all of you who loved Relic Hunters and supported us in this grand adventure! We are a small team from Brazil with very big dreams and you are helping make them come true. Thank you with all our hearts!

Posts like this will be opportunities for us to talk about the game's development, and also to talk to you—our community—to keep you in touch with what we’re working on, and what is coming next in Early Access!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/b98f41b32d8524e97d046304954b05cee15cd145.png[/img]

Launch went well and overall server stability is pretty good! We haven’t had any long outages since launch, and apart from a few hiccups on day 1, our servers seem to be generally well-behaved.
Overall, we've seen very positive sentiment about the game itself, the core gameplay, the story, and the RPG systems—with the vast majority of negative reviews being about the current technical state of the Early Access build. The overall sentiment from negative reviews was "this game has a lot of potential, it just needs to be more stable before I can recommend it".

Although the early parts of the game and story content seem stable enough, we’ve made mistakes when it comes to the technical state of the endgame. We’ve fixed a LOT of things since launch, but there still are a lot of serious technical problems that we are working hard on addressing, including but not limited to:

[list]
[*] Some Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis (ADN) missions are unstable when played in multiplayer, and can soft lock or crash sometimes;
[*] Some skill and item combinations in Raff and Jimmy are causing performance issues that can lead to sync issues, crashes or soft locks;
[*] Sometimes Delve bosses don't spawn their exit portal;
[*] Trading has some general instability and can be a bit buggy and unreliable at times;
[*] When playing Epic missions in a sequence, backend errors can be frequent and occasionally require 	players to restart the game;
[*] Players are sometimes getting temporarily stuck in the dropship when joining a game in progress
[/list]

We are also aware that the current endgame balance is not fulfilling your expectations. Compared to Raff, the rest of the Hunters feel underpowered and weak. Even so, there seems to be a decently healthy variety of builds being used in endgame, so it's a good sign that with a few more updates and tweaks we can bring the game to a great spot balance-wise!

Finally, the endgame didn't hold much interest after about 80-100 hours of play, and you are waiting for more content and/or major features. Honestly, this is actually not bad for our first Early Access release, and we are hopeful for the future, as we will explain below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/dcc9dfbd3cc64813f9585f500be036c3b57482cf.png[/img]

We heard you and are currently investigating adding an Offline Mode to the game before it's out of Early Access! Our goal is for you to be able to enjoy Relic Hunters Legend even when you're somewhere without an internet connection (or if servers are down for maintenance).

This is early in development, so we will share more information at a later date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d8e989d1a699c03a668480f285ce7b1dd79e16e7.png[/img]

We are aware that, for some of you, being restricted from playing Story content in multiplayer is annoying. We are a very small team making a huge RPG, so we have to be very careful about where to dedicate our resources, and unfortunately, that’s a really hard change to make at this stage. We’ve made the difficult decision to keep Story missions single player and to invest our attention into making other parts of the game stronger.

We understand that some of you will disagree! At the end of the day, game development is full of hard choices like this where there isn't a clear "right" answer.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/ac08cf50a29fed20c588737b4899aff06cf94f8f.png[/img]

I played the game myself alongside you all for 40+ hours at release and the whole team have been watching livestreams, playthroughs, and feedback posted on our Discord.

We were shocked and felt really bad to see the game performing badly and making players frustrated, when we all put so much love and care into making it.

The team and I took a step back and looked at some of our technical infrastructure supporting the game's systems. We are serious about addressing everything that the community has spoken up about at launch, but that is a big undertaking.

We are balancing our time and prioritizing fixing known issues while also working towards a larger update that we’re looking forward to sharing with you all when we can.

Our goal is that, whenever the next big update hits, players will come back to a much more stable and enjoyable experience. We are super grateful for your patience, and we are doing our best to make sure it is rewarded!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/ed53d749e8ee2ea882c298be52540686669f5795.png[/img]

We have been working on a first big Early Access update that is due next year!
Here's what to expect:

[list]
[*] Bug fixes and technical stability;
[*] "Treasure Maps" endgame system, with over 100 new levels, new gear, new weapons, new Relics, a new Faction and new Rebel Rank Chapters;
[*] A new playable Hunter (who do you think it'll be?);
[*] New balance and items made to make all Hunters strong and fun to play;
[/list]
We have no release date yet, as we want to make sure we fix the majority of serious technical issues before making the game bigger. But hopefully you are as excited as I am to jump back into the game when the new update hits and farm some loot in Maps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e06c9efb97f7bd4b1639d3d42b83af67ef24c8c1.png[/img]

That’s it for our first State of the Game post! If you've read it all until this point, I commend you for your commitment—I know it was a lot of text! But hopefully it was a good read and made you feel like we are all on the same page about how to make this game better!

If not—that's okay too! Tell us about it (respectfully, please!), as the team over at Rogue Snail will be keeping a close eye on community discussions here on Steam, on our Discord, and on social media.
We are only just beginning, and we are grateful for having you all along for the adventure!

[url=https://discord.gg/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]

Cheers,
~Mark

notes.title: Relic Hunters Legend - Patch Notes 0.8.7
notes.content:
[i]Relic Hunters Legend - Patch Notes 0.8.7[/i]

Hey Hunters,

We have an exciting new patch update to help further update some quality-of-life improvements that have been suggested by [b]YOU[/b], the community! Keep the suggestions coming and we’ll continue to make [i]Relic Hunters Legend[/i] the BEST game in all the galaxy!


To make sure your feedback continues to be heard, join our Discord![url= https://discord.gg/relichunters] https://discord.gg/relichunters[/url]


[h2]Patch Notes- October 19th[/h2]
=======================

[list]
[*] Jet Boots no longer required to be unequipped and equipped again in order to work
[*] Ultimate Skills being interrupted will no longer result in players being unable to move
[*] Nanocloak is no longer blocking players from using Skills
[*] When players start casting a Skill they will no longer get stuck if they are being pushed at the same time
[*] Players joining after the mission has started are no longer being spawned at the Dropship
[*] Salty Galaxy Shake blasts no longer causes Silence. This prevents players from experiencing chain reactions which could cause the game to crash
[*] K.R.O.N.K will now drop items when defeated in the Broken Era
[*] When completing the Old Town Mission on the Broken Era players will receive loot 
[/list]

During our testing, we found that the previous change to Raff (update 0.8.6) was no longer applying as intended.  We've since re-applied the change to make sure she was at a comparable level to the other Hunters.


--

Thanks again to our fantastic community members, all of whom have helped to make Relic Hunters Legend what it is today! We will continue to take player feedback and provide regular updates to help improve the player experience.

If you are having any issues with Relic Hunters Legend please reach out to our support team here: http://bit.ly/RHLOpenTicket


[h2]Known Issues Update [/h2]

Hey there, Hunters! We appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm for our game. As you know, we're constantly working to improve your gaming experience. Here's an update on some of the known issues we're actively addressing:

1.[b] Backend issues[/b]
[list]
[*] We are aware that some players are facing issues with the game's backend, and we are already working to fix them. If you encounter any backend error messages, we ask that you continue to report them using our in-game Bug Report Tool (pressing F3). If you cannot use the in-game tool, please get in touch with our Customer Support team. (http://bit.ly/RHLOpenTicket)
[/list]
2. [b]Localization issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Shift Overlay may display incorrect language in 'Rewards History' section.
[*] Abapotim daily quest "Defeat Fluffy Junior" displays debug texts in the title and description.
[*] Typo in the word "you".
[*] Buffs and Debuffs are not appearing in Chinese, Korean and Japanese
[*] Some translations are wrong in Russian
[*] There are a few lines in some Story Missions that are in English even if you are playing in other languages
[*] Certain Item Affixes only have their texts written in English.
[/list]
3. [b]General issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Help Others Positive Reviews can be incorrectly reset if cap is reached.
[*] Kami slides and stays outside the cage in the Story mission.
[*] Raff's and Pinkyy's Ultimates sometimes crashes the game.
[*] Player's skill trees sometimes break and all trees are displayed as The Iron.
[*] Players can only see their own custom cosmetics setup on Scoreboard screen.
[*] Sometimes enemies are not interrupted when defeated or when crowd-controlled.
[*] By skipping the dialogue with the Bartender at the Secret Market, the player may suffer a Soft Lock
[*] Using a melee attack on enemies as Seven has a small chance of rendering guns non functional.
[*] Collecting a Legendary Weapon doesn't complete its respective Rebel Feat until game is restarted.
[*] Pinkyy's Short Fuse skill does not work.
[*] Path to Breaking the Silence is not accessible in a specific condition after reaching Rebel Rank 1.
[*] When player uses Keytar Blast skill during Raffs's ult, she will swap the Keytar for the previously equipped weapon.
[*] Wrong announcements are being played during Rift and Distraction missions.
[*] No error message is displayed to users when sending a whisper to a player that does not exist.
[*] Players can get stuck in a falling state due to appearing blocks in the End of Time
[*] Players from China are having connection issues
[*] Gamepad requires the deactivation of Steam Input instead of working plug & play
[*] After changing screen resolution, the revert button doesn't reset it back.
[*] Completing chapter/ranking up with Rebel Rank takes longer to register.
[*] Players can get stuck on a white screen when skipping the cutscene of "Home Is Where The Heart Is" relic hunt mission.
[*] Players with their OS set to Turkish can't authenticate in the game.
[*] Pinkyy Skill Node Knuckle Lady is not affecting Duck Puncher.
[*] Enemies at Old Town may spawn out of bounds and prevent progress of the match.
[*] "Jack of Spades" quest is not marked on the map and cannot be completed.
[*] Other players’ auras and trading icon are still visible in the Shooting Stand during “Fight Like a Rebel" missions.
[*] Enhanced items, which should not be traded, are being tradeable.
[*] Mission objectives cannot be completed after the Party Leader leaves. 
[*] Game Mode Announcements are sometimes reset when the game is paused during a match.
[*] World Map paths sometimes do not represent the actual map node connection state properly.
[*] Sometimes certain Faction Quests mark all MapNodes as relevant to the completion of those Quests.
[*] Players may get soft-locked when playing Fight Like a Rebel's first Quest, due to their weapons not working properly during this mission. Leaving the Secret Market and reentering fixes this issue.
[*] Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis Greater Timeline map nodes have their graphics misaligned.
[*] 
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and understanding as we work to address these issues. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please continue to report any problems you encounter through our official channels.

We're committed to providing the best gaming experience possible, and your support is what keeps us going! Stay tuned for upcoming patches and improvements.

Happy gaming, and we'll see you in Relic Hunters Legend universe!

Along this journey, we’re going to be making many different types of changes, that will touch on all areas of the game. They’re all being made only after much consideration by our team of devs, and with the long-term vision of building a game that is both fun and challenging. 

To make sure your feedback continues to be heard, join our Discord!

[h2]Addressed the following concerns from players:[/h2]

[*] A black screen would appear to some players when entering the Secret Market

If you find bugs that aren't on this list, you can report them using the steps below! Thank you so much for being a part of our community, Hunter! ⭐ 
 
 
[h2]REPORTING BUGS [/h2]
 
 
[h1]In-Game Bug Report Tool[/h1]
 
If you encounter any issues while playing, there’s a handy built-in bug-reporting tool! 
To access it, hit F3 on your keyboard. This will automatically take a screenshot and attach it to your report, so our team knows where the issue happened. 
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/36e3cb4f150e40d59dc86316adf7b4aee12f338a.png[/img]

Next, fill out the Description text box with: 
 
[list]
[*] What you were doing when the issue arose 
[*] What the issue (bug) was 
[*] Where you found it 
[/list]
 
 
For instance, if the audio suddenly cut out while playing in the Galyno Canyon stage, you would hit F3 and write: 
 
 
“While playing in the Galyno Canyon stage with my party, the sound of the weapons disappeared right after I switched weapons and didn’t come back”. 
 
 
Please feel free to report any bugs you encounter, no matter how simple they may seem. Each bug report is valuable information for our team and helps us make Relic Hunters Legend even better!

notes.title: Overview of Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis
notes.content:
[i]*This is a planned feature for Early Access.[/i]


Hey Hunters! We have some [b]EXCITING[/b] news for you! 

Early Access is quickly approaching, and what better way to celebrate that than with a WEEKLY [b]ACTIVITY[/b]!

You'll be able to embark on weekly missions with randomized challenges and awesome loot in Relic Hunters Legend!

                                               [h3]Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/028de6df4b36b6c187a5b09ae605e29ff57508fb.png[/img]

The Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis is one of the biggest endgame features in Relic Hunters Legend. In this WEEKLY activity, you'll receive the best loot this galaxy has ever seen by conquering increasingly challenging missions.

As you start the activity, you'll enter arenas with different challenges that progressively become more difficult. You'll have 5 missions to conquer in this game mode, and each mission will only unlock after you've successfully completed the previous challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/501b1dc06662b59a098b2e37b5142564743a194b.png[/img]

You'll choose a Hunter to undertake a mission, but choose wisely because you can’t choose the same Hunter twice! Once you beat a stage with a certain hunter, you won't be able to select them for the upcoming missions, so it's essential to manage your resources and strategize about who is the best Hunter to use in each given challenge. 


                                                      [h3]The Loot[/h3]

How fun would this weekly activity be without some sweet, sweet loot! As you progress in the Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis you will be rewarded with some of the best loot the galaxy has ever seen!

Upon completing each mission, you'll receive a chest with incredible rewards, and the deeper you go into the Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis the stronger the loot will be. 

But remember: you can only get these loot drops [b]ONCE[/b] a week!

Each Floor has a Chest that can be looted once per week (separated for Regular and Greater Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis). These Chests can contain:

[olist]
[*] Legendary Materials
[*] Endgame Gears and Weapons
[*] A lot of Bounty
[/olist]


                                                     [h3] Missions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/cba5f597dc1d3baf2021d905bcece3f4904ac68c.png[/img]

The mission selection and game modes are randomized every week, and you can play the Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis solo or with a party. However, be aware that each mission encourages the use of different builds, strategies, and Hunters. So, it's best to team up with friends to secure your victory!

You can reset any completed activity as many times as you want to test new strategies, but the rewards you've already obtained won't reappear until the next weekly rotation. Also, be aware: the reset will be applied to ALL the Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis missions completed, so think carefully about how to use this feature!

There are two ways for players to group up and take on Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis Activities:

Regular Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis: for up to 2 players
Greater Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis: for up to 4 players


Each activity consists of 5 missions and is divided into different Tiers, as follows:

[list]
[*] Tier 1: Missions 1 and 2, considered the easiest
[*] Tier 2: Missions 3, 4, and 5, which are significantly more difficult
[/list]


This activity is not for the faint of heart, and if you love a good challenge and want to push your skills to the max, make sure to gather your crew and wishlist Relic Hunters Legend today for our Early Access on September 25th!

notes.title: Relic Hunters Legend: Relic Overview!
notes.content:
Okay Hunters, [b]POP-QUIZ TIME!! [/b]

If you’re out traveling the Galaxy and need some extra power to take down some WICKED Ducan baddies, what is a must-have item?

The answer: [b]RELICS![/b]

If you’re new to Hunting and Relics and being, well, a Relic Hunter, you might not know exactly why these are good to have equipped. That’s why we have this handy-dandy breakdown of what Relics are and how you get them.

[h2]What is a Relic[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/14035504026c725feccd906ab701324e80b63f95.png[/img]

Relics are a special type of Gear with their own unique slot in the Backpack and can be leveled up with XP to become more powerful and unlock new affixes.

There are different types of Relics out there in the Galaxy and each one has its own unique power advantages and affixes. You can collect them all and switch them out depending on what evil forces you’re going up against.

Relics can only be acquired by crafting them using a special consumable item called a “Relic Blueprint.” Each Relic Blueprint has a riddle hinting where the player can drop the Relic Pieces, and it’s usually 3 unique Relic Pieces + a few Materials.

[h2]How Relic Works[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f654cb0818b6a42e7523e635fe741ed111764017.gif[/img]

Power doesn’t come easy, and from obtaining a Relic to then leveling will take some time and diligent work, but the power you’ll wield through it is truly worth the effort it takes to get a Relic to max level.
Levels and Progression

Much like Hunter levels, Relic levels progress as you complete missions and objectives. All XP earned by the Hunter in Missions is also earned by the currently equipped Relic. Your Relic will also continue to gain XP even if your Hunter is level-capped. All Relics are level-capped at 30.

Another way to level up Relics is by using Memories! Right-clicking the Relic will open its details screen, and it can be leveled up with Memories there. It’s important to keep in mind that if you use a Memory directly from your inventory, only your Hunter will gain XP – even if they have a Relic equipped.   

[h2]Affixes and Power[/h2]

By leveling your Relic, you’ll get super cool bonuses, making your Hunter even more POWERFUL! This is extremely helpful while you are duck-punching your way to save the Galaxy!

Affixes help boost the power level of your Relic! Each Relic has three unique affixes that are unlocked and grow in power as the Relic levels up. 

The first affix is already unlocked from level 1, the second is unlocked at level 15, and the third is unlocked at level 30.
Relic affixes have a “min” and a “max” value. Affixes start at the “min” value at Level 1 and increase with every level, reaching the “max” value at Level 30.

[b]Example:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/6fadb58097e00bb70150f68cc6dda888f98ca156.png[/img]

[b]The Scanner[/b]

1.	[Level 1] Every 10 seconds, create an area that gives +(10-30%) Weapon Damage
2.	[Level 15] Reload Speed inside the area increased by +(15-40%)
3.	[Level 30] Enemies inside the area have their Resistance reduced by 20%

[h2]Relic Hunt[/h2]

New to Relic Hunters Legend is a unique Adventure called Relic Hunt! During a Relic Hunt players will be rewarded with a Relic Blueprint that can be used to craft a Relic.

Now, like most Hunts, these adventures are not for the faint of heart and take significant effort to accomplish. They require the player to venture out into the Galaxy looking for hidden puzzles that will trigger the adventure to start. Sometimes (although rarely) a Relic Hunt will be triggered by finding a unique key item in a chest.

These puzzles are not easy to find, so always look for anything that seems odd or areas you have yet to explore because you never know what is hiding around every corner. 


After you complete the puzzle and talk to some interesting characters in-game, you will be rewarded with a unique blueprint that lists the Relic parts required to craft a specific Relic.

Relic parts and materials can be found while playing Missions, defeating mobs, and taking down Champions. 


So there you have it, Hunters! A nifty little guide to Relics. If you were looking for exact locations, we aren’t the ones to spoil the fun, but you can always join our Discord server and pair up with other Hunters to search for Relics once Relic Hunters Legend goes into Early Access on September 25th!

[h2]The Road to Update 1.0[/h2]

Here at Rogue Snail, we are excited to share that we’re already busy crafting even more content releasing in the 1.0 update! Our plans include additional Hunters joining the roster of playable characters, the EPIC conclusion to the story, and more! These additions have been in development for a while, and we’re putting in extra effort to make sure they’re where we want them before they become part of the game.

Throughout the Early Access period, we’ll be gathering feedback through surveys, community discussions, player data, and other avenues to make informed decisions on future content. This information will be important in improving features and adding new features to make Relic Hunters Legend the best game in the Galaxy!

We appreciate everyone who has joined our journey in making Relic Hunters Legend something special. It has been a long time in the making, and we are working diligently to grow and improve this universe for all.

[h2]Early Access FAQ[/h2]

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
Relic Hunters Legend would not be the game it is today without the feedback and support of our community. With Early Access, we can gather even more crucial feedback to help improve the game even more, and continue to grow the amazing community that has supported us through the years.

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]

Our focus is to make sure that development has the time it needs to produce the best experience of the game possible. We have a lot planned for the full release, and will continue to add content in the coming months! 

[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]

The full version of Relic Hunters Legend will feature additional Hunters, the EPIC conclusion to the story, and more!

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]

Relic Hunters Legend goes into Early Access with the first two Acts to explore, a ton of loot and gear to collect, five unlockable Hunters to play, and eight different types of missions to play with friends or other players across the Galaxy. It’s a robust introduction to the world we are developing, and a great jumping off point for the content we’ll be adding further into development.

[b]How are you planning on involving the community in your development process?[/b]

We’ve always had a community-focus in the development of Relic Hunters Legend. We believe that seeing how players respond to the game and interact with other community members will help us make the best version of the game possible. We have done various Closed Betas with our Founders on Discord and received a ton of great feedback around those. It’s a conversation we’re continuing to keep open!

We are collecting feedback and suggestions through the Steam Discussion forums, as well as our Relic Hunters Universe [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Discord Server[/url].

[h2]New to Relic Hunters Legend[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/2709c648f2020d0b3839a8094b12eb760aece815.gif[/img]

Howdy, Hunter in training! I’m surprised you made it this far to read what Relic Hunters Legend is, but I’m glad you’re here!
Relic Hunters Legend invites players to:


[b]Be A Rebel [/b]–  A vibrant, lore-rich world with an equally colorful and unique cast of characters, each with their own abilities, playstyles, and personalities.
 
[b]Power Up[/b] – Explore a variety of highly replayable missions as you comb your way through the universe, gathering powerful loot and facing off against intergalactic threats. With a wide range of weapons, gear, and skills to unlock and suit the way you play, Relic Hunters Legend is fun to learn and challenging to master. 

[b]Conquer Adventures [/b]–  There are many ways for players to experience this new world. They can dive in solo to experience the Story Mode; group up with friends in the online co-op mode; or meet new, fellow Hunters in missions designed for up to four players.

[b]Take Back Time[/b] – Play as the mysterious character Seven and unlock all the playable Relic Hunter characters in the single-player Story Mode campaign. Uncover a story about time travel, lost memories, and friendship while facing off against the tyrannical Duke Ducan and his evil minions.

You can also read some of our past blog posts which talk about topics such as Ways to Play, Guide to Weapons, Guide to Gear, What are Relics, and the Jimmy and Ace character showcase.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Community[/url] to meet, talk, and play with other Hunters!

notes.title: Ways to Play - Relic Hunters Legend!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, did you know there are multiple ways to play Relic Hunters Legend?

[previewyoutube=ya3sxHQxzr4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Singleplayer[/h2]

Fight back against the evil Ducan empire with your band of Rebels in Relic Hunters Legend’s single-player Story mode!

The villainous duck, Duke Ducan, has somehow stolen the past and tells everyone that he is responsible for everything good that has ever happened—providing legitimacy to his oppressive galactic regime.

The Relic Hunters, led by Pinkyy, travel around the Galaxy looking for Relics of the old civilization, trying to restore the memory of the true Past. In this journey, Pinkyy and her crew—Jimmy, Ace, Raff, Biu, and Jimmy’s little sister, Panzer—meet a new mysterious ally named Seven.

Seven has suffered the tragic loss of all their memories, and it’s up to YOU to re-discover their AWESOME time travel abilities!

Throughout Story Mode, you’ll gradually uncover new mysteries from the past and learn the true potential of Seven’s abilities. You’ll also unlock other playable Hunters through Friendship Missions, each with a unique playstyle, abilities, and backstories (along with tons of weapons and loot to upgrade your arsenal).


Find the Hunter with the playstyle that suits you best, or swap between them to fit the next mission. Hunters also have their own gear preferences, so all that SWEET loot you're getting while playing can be shared across each character.


[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/17ba6737f55909638a5bea629375356657e55bbd.gif[/img]

Taking down the EVIL Ducans is hard work, so join Hunters from around the world and bash their butts together!

Dive into different mission modes, like Skirmish, Scavenge, Payload, AND MORE!

As you unlock characters in the Story Mode, you can add them to your Mission roster, selecting the best Rebel for the job. And regardless of your friends' story progress, you can play Missions together—even if they're ahead or behind.

[b]Skirmish[/b]


Move forward through the level, defeating all the enemies you encounter! Clearing an area will open a portal for the next round. Advance until you find the enemy’s  Champion. Defeat them to earn incredible rewards and obtain unique legendary weapons and gear!!

[b]Scavenge[/b]


Capture the Excavation Points, and don't let the enemies control them. Stand inside the capture area to increase your progress bar, and don't allow enemies to hinder or contest this scavaging point!

[b]Payload[/b]

Capture the payload and guide it to the end of the level. Standing inside the capture area will make the Payload move, and don't let any enemies contest it because they will try to hinder your progress!

[b]Defense[/b]

In Defense mode, you must protect your treasure chests from special enemies who slowly advance toward them! Special enemies are immune to damage unless you defeat all the regular enemies protecting them. So you must defeat all the enemies quickly, and don't let them destroy your precious treasure chests!

[b]Distraction[/b]

In Distraction mode, you need to keep the enemies alarmed by your presence while other Rebels complete their missions elsewhere! Fill up the Alert Meter by defeating enemies quickly. But be careful: A Special enemy will sometimes figure out your ruse and try to Call You Out to the base. Defeat them before they do! You get more rewards if you keep the Alert Meter high.

[b]Exploration[/b]


In exploration mode, you can explore the area as you please, defeating enemies and finding loot! Try to explore all the areas and find every chest. There are also dangerous Champion enemies lurking around, so be careful! You can leave the exploration areas anytime you want by interacting with the exit beacon.

[b]Delve[/b]

Welcome to Delve mode! You are free to explore this mini-Dungeon as you see fit, but this is a dangerous place! There are many Bosses you can defeat, and you may leave whenever you wish. But to challenge the final Boss, you will need to find a Boss Key. You have a limited number of lives and can only earn extra lives by defeating a Boss. Run out of lives and the Mission is over.

[b]Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis[/b]

The Asteroid Dungeon Nemesis will be available in Early Access, and it's the biggest endgame feature we have so far. In this Weekly Activity, you'll receive the best loot this galaxy has ever seen by conquering increasingly challenging missions.

On the ADN, you'll enter arenas with different challenges that progressively become more difficult. You'll have 5 missions to conquer in this activity, and each mission will only unlock after you've successfully completed the previous challenge.


Each Mission has a unique map that can be replayed as often as you like. As you start to unlock different Acts, you can go to different zones and experience these Mission types in various terrains and against different kinds of baddies.

If you LOVE loot, Missions are also a great way to get the most ELITE gear and weapons. As you take down the Ducans with your fellow Hunters, you will have so much loot at your disposal, and sometimes even get lucky when a Champion drops a Legendary item!

With the flexibility in Story Mode and Missions, you can easily find a way to play that fits your style. Let us know in the comments what your favorite way to play is!

notes.title: Guide to Gear!
notes.content:
Hunters, we need to talk about style and gear RIGHT NOW!  
It’s fun, it gets you ready to go up against bigger baddies, and most importantly, it looks cool.  
 
 
[h2][b]Gear & Gear Types [/b][/h2]
 
Each Hunters possesses five unique Gear slots to help you maximize your build. Each piece grants additional bonuses, and different Hunters have their own style and gear preferences!  
 
 Jimmy and Ace are most comfortable wearing Light Clothes that allow for agility, whereas Pinkyy, Seven, and Raff opt for Heavy Clothes, allowing for a little more defense. 
 
 
Raff, Ace, and Seven can actively equip Light Shields, while Jimmy opts for Heavy Shields. Pinkyy, on the other hand, foregoes Shields in favor of Armor. 
 
 
Each Hunter can only wear certain types of Gear, so take a moment to check if the gear you buy or loot can be worn by your chosen Hunter! 
 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/8b7940da99381ed96d10f7aa0850c548a965a643.jpg[/img]
 
 
 
[h2]Enhancements  [/h2]
 
Loot luck isn’t the only way to get stronger! Materials from defeated Ducans and recycled items can be used to Enhance the power of your gear! 

And the higher the Tier, the more it can be Enhanced! For example, Tier 1 Gear go up to +5, while Tier 4 Gear can go up to +20. This helps boost your overall Gear Score, giving you more fighting power. 
 
 
While it might be daunting to spend materials on an item, you will get a lot of the materials back when you Recycle an item.
 
 
The rarity of your gear also impacts your Hunters Gear Score, which is a special Stat that represents how well-equipped your Hunter is and will give extra bonus the higher rank you get! 
 
 
[h2]Gear Designs [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/6a12c2334412cbb6eaed6bf7acf267b36821b260.jpg[/img]
 
When taking down Ducans you gotta look stylish! Each piece of gear has a unique design, so while you’re out fighting the Ducan Empire be on the lookout for some stylish-looking gear.
 
You can also personalize your Hunter’s appearance by using cosmetic skins from the in-game store. 
 
  
Ready to get your hands on all that incredible gear and unleash your inner Relic Hunter? Well, you're in luck, my fearless friends! If you want to experience the thrill of collecting and trying on these awesome pieces for yourself, then make sure to Wishlist Relic Hunters Legend today! 


We can't wait to see you on the battlefield, clad in the most epic gear and wielding the most powerful weapons. 


Cheers ~

notes.title: Closed Beta 2 - Progression Hotfix
notes.content:
Good news, Hunters!

A hotfix is now live for both of the bugs that were causing some of you to lose progress. Currently, there were two bugs that are causing this loss:

[olist]
[*] Players receive an error after each match and lose the progress of that match due to a Backend issue that duplicates information.
[*] The second bug is caused by connection instability, which causes the game to stop sending information to the server. After this error occurs, the player loses all the progress that would have been made after it happened.
[/olist]

We were able to identify the source of both problems and a fix has been implemented. 

Thank you for your unwavering patience, and as always, Happy Hunting!

[h2]FAQ Regarding Patch Update[/h2]

Q: Do I need to restart my game after the patch? 
A: You’ll need to close the game, let Steam update, and then jump back in. Happy Hunting! ⭐️

Q: Is the hotfix only for Multiplayer?
A: Nope! This patch update addresses issues in both multiplayer and Story Mode. Relog & patch to explore smoothly! Happy Hunting 🚀⭐️

Q:  Will the patch remove or change my progress?
A: We hope you’ve enjoyed the story so far! Your progress won’t be impacted by the update. You’ll need to log out, exit the game and relog back in. The patch will have been installed, and you’ll be good to go from there. Happy Hunting! ⭐️

Q: How do I relog and patch?
A:  To relog, exit the game and relog back in. For patching, the game should automatically update when you launch it! Enjoy CB2 ⭐️

Q: Can I continue playing without the hotfix?
A: While the game is still accessible even if you haven’t installed the patch, we recommend downloading the hotfix for the best user experience in order to progress and play with friends who have.


Q: I haven’t had issues regarding this hotfix, but I’m having another bug issue with the game. Where can I report bugs?
A: For any bug-related issues you can reach out to our support team here: [url=https://bit.ly/RHLOpenTicket]https://bit.ly/RHLOpenTicket[/url]

Q: How can I tell that I’ve installed the hotfix correctly?
A: To install the hotfix, you’ll need to exit the game and relog back in. The game should automatically be patched once you continue your adventure, even if you don’t notice any changes. Enjoy CB2!

notes.title: CLOSED BETA 2: What’s New and Known Issues
notes.content:
We are so excited for everyone to jump into the second Closed Beta Relic Hunters Legend’s on  
July 20th at 9AM CT, until July 24th at 9AM CT! 
 
This Closed Beta is bringing a bunch of new things for you to experience into the game! 

[list]
[*] [b][h3]Relics are now available![/h3] [/b][/list][olist]
[*] Relics are a special type of Gear that are unique, have their own unique slot in the Backpack, and can be leveled up with XP to become more powerful and unlock new affixes. 
[*] Relics can only be acquired by crafting them, using a special consumable called “Relic Blueprint.” The Blueprint will list the materials needed to Craft, but it’s usually 3 unique Relic Pieces + a few Materials. 
[*] Relics also require a minimum REBEL RANK before you are able to craft and use it. [/olist]
[list][*][b] [h3]Relic Hunt is now available[/h3] [/b][/list][olist][*] A special Adventure that rewards players with a Relic Blueprint. 
[*] Relic Hunts usually take some effort to be triggered. Ex: The player must solve a puzzle hidden in a level, get a specific item, and talk to an NPC. Then the adventure starts. 
[*] Players can also trigger Relic Hunts by finding a unique key item (with a very low drop chance) in a chest. 
[*] There will only be one available Relic Hunt during Closed Beta 2. 
[/olist]
[b][list][*][h3] Small changes to Ace and Jimmy's skill trees[/h3] [/list][/b]
 
Players can continue to enjoy unlocking playable Hunters through story mode, and jump into missions either solo, with friends, or with Hunters from around the world to comb the universe for powerful loot and face off against the evil Ducans. 
 
In addition, the progress for players that joined the Closed Beta: Stress Test and Closed Beta 1 will be kept for this Closed Beta. 
  
[h2]KNOWN ISSUES [/h2]
 
This is an in-development build of Relic Hunters Legend, so you may encounter some issues while you play. Below are some of the known issues you may encounter: 
 
[list]
[*] Sometimes the beam from Seven's ultimate is invisible to other Players 
[*] LT Speedy will occasionally run away from players and leave the boss fight arena 
[*] Armor Breaker in Special Missions provides 0% bonus Nature Damage 
[*] There is an invisible ceiling above the red chest in "No Man's Land" 
[*] Feats cards disappear when they are claimed in quick succession. 
[*] The Spirit stat description does not explain that the stat increases healing value. 
[*] Seven's face may disappear during certain cutscenes. 
[*] Players can get stuck in specific areas on different missions. 
[*] Players can get trapped between props on different maps. 
[*] Some performance issues during missions. 
[*] Occasionally the application will crash upon quitting the game. 
[/list]
 
 
If you find bugs that aren't on this list, you can report them using the steps below! Thank you so much for being a part of our community, Hunter! ⭐ 
 
 
[h2]REPORTING BUGS [/h2]
  
[h3]In-Game Bug Reporter [/h3]
 
If you encounter any issues while playing, there’s a handy built-in bug-reporting tool! 
To access it, hit F3 on your keyboard. This will automatically take a screenshot and attach it to your report, so our team knows where the issue happened. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/36e3cb4f150e40d59dc86316adf7b4aee12f338a.png[/img]
 
Next, fill out the Description text box with: 
 
[list]
[*] What you were doing when the issue arose 
[*] What the issue (bug) was 
[*] Where you found it 
[/list]
 
For instance, if the audio suddenly cut out while playing in the Galyno Canyon stage, you could hit F3 and write: 
 
While playing in the Galyno Canyon stage with my party, the sound of the weapons disappeared right after I switched weapons and didn’t come back”. 
 
Please feel free to report any bugs you encounter, no matter how simple they may seem. Each bug report is valuable information for our team and helps us make Relic Hunters Legend even better! 
 
Thanks again for helping us test the servers for this closed beta.

notes.title: Guide to Weapon & Gear Stats
notes.content:
Hey there, Hunters! Let's face it, having the perfect gear by your side is a big deal when taking on the evil Ducan Empire! 

We're diving headfirst into the weapons and gear stats in Relic Hunters Legend. Ready to unleash your inner warrior? Great! Because we're about to share the countless ways which weapons and gear can transform you into an unstoppable force. 

[h2]Weapon & Gear Rarity  [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/133379a031890c8432274f3e859ff1b3f8503e5d.jpg[/img]

Relic Hunters Legend features different Tiers and Rarities of Gear. Tiers represent the Gear's level and Enhancement capacity, and Rarity represents the amount and type of Affixes a Gear has. 

Your Gear’s Tier also affects your Gear Score, which is a special stat that reflects your Hunter's equipment quality. It will also provide additional bonuses as your Gear Score gets higher. 

[h2]Affixes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/9e401bc82a0f60b5d288bd06f7b4ee667f37203b.jpg[/img]

Affixes are bonuses that come together with your gear. From simple ones like "+5% Base Movement Speed" to complex powerhouses like "Shooting while in the air gives you +100% Critical Chance", affixes can shape your playstyle.  
  
Affixes come in varying intensities. A pair of boots may bestow "+12% Base Movement Speed" instead of a meager "+5% Base Movement Speed." The better the Rarity of your weapon, the more Affixes it has. Embrace their diversity, as they help you become a stronger Hunter!  

[h2]Gear Score[/h2]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f6dcdcfa4a745cc25cb4d5d001b68479212736f4.jpg[/img]

The Tier of your Gear also affects your Hunter’s Gear Score, which is a special Stat that stands for how well-equipped your Hunter is and will give extra bonus the higher rank you get!  

Achieving a higher Gear Score rank not only means your Gear is of overall higher quality, but also unlocks cool benefits for your character, such as new portrait borders, a new look for the Hunter, and significant overall bonuses to Attack and Defense values.  
  
If you’d like a more visual breakdown of these topics view our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playrelichunters]TikTok here[/url]! Also, if you want to see the power of gear and weapon stats for yourself sign up for the next Closed Beta on the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/633080/Relic_Hunters_Legend/] Relic Hunters Steam Page[/url]!

notes.title: Guide to Weapons
notes.content:
Hey Hunters!  
Today we’re diving into the explosive world of WEAPONS! Who doesn’t enjoy unlocking the best loot? We’ll examine their unique strengths and strategies for BLASTING EVIL DUCANS!

[h2]Damage Types [/h2]

Weapons in Relic Hunters Legend offer two kinds of damage: Physical and Elemental. Each has its own unique damage effects, allowing you to optimize your attacks and exploit enemy weaknesses. 

[h3]Physical Damage Types [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/3678946e39ed9220568ddf2d93b85405da23a366.gif[/img]

Physical Damage weapons take down shields with ease. There are three types of Physical Damage: [b]Impact[/b], [b]Frag[/b], and [b]Magnetic[/b].  

Impact damage is the most common form you’ll see. They do +25% extra damage against shields and can stun some targets, helping you gain control of chaotic battles.

Frag damage causes Injury, which inflicts continuous physical damage and deals extra punishment to Health. It also boasts a +25% damage bonus against Shields, ensuring no obstacle can withstand your assault. 

Magnetic damage, the rarest and most coveted type, wreaks havoc on Shields with a staggering +75% increased damage. Strikes can Silence enemies, rendering them unable to use special Skills. 

[h3]Elemental Damage Type [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/2709c648f2020d0b3839a8094b12eb760aece815.gif[/img]
For those who enjoy the elements, Elemental Damage offers three types: Fire, Water, and Nature. 

Fire damage inflicts Burn, gradually damaging the target over time and dealing additional harm. It also provides a +25% damage bonus against Armor. 

Water damage Freezes foes, immobilizing targets and buying time to eliminate other units and heal. It also provides a +25% damage bonus against Armor. 

Nature damage counters regenerative abilities, inflicting Contagion, rendering targets immune to healing from any source.  It also provides a +75% damage bonus against Armor. 

Choose your weapons wisely and utilize their diverse damage types to take on any challenge. 

[h2]Weapon Types  [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e9ff5c60a7885de144411fb4d7e2a6e80b44a899.png[/img]

Whether you're a fan of Pistols, Auto Rifles, Marksman Rifles, Shotguns, SMGs, Machine Guns, and more, there’s a weapon for every playstyle—heck there are even Grenade Launchers!  

Love sniping? Our Legendary Marksman Rifle, the Trick Shot, has got you covered! Its bonus effects give your Hunter a 100% Critical Chance while shooting in the air! Get up high and fly while shooting down at your foes. 

Wanna do some super extra damage? The Legendary SMG, Grim Reaper, is feared by all Ducans, dealing an extra 20% damage for each Condition (Stun, Injury, Silence, Burn, Freeze or Contagion) the targets are suffering from. No Ducan stands a chance! 

If you use the Legendary Pistol, All Second Chances, you'll be able to increase Critical Damage by +25% (max stacks 5) for every shot that is not a Critical Hit! Everyone deserves a second chance, after all! 
That’s just a brief look into some of the awesome weapons Relic Hunters Legends have, there are so many more to be discovered! 

[h2]Weapon Stats [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/1debafafe7ccc448af478531e2c895fba7afee46.jpg[/img]
Weapon Stats let you know how strong a weapon can be! These stats are determined by three key attributes: Tier, Affixes, and Enhancement Level. For more power, be on the lookout for weapons with a higher Tier Rarity!

Affixes provide unique gameplay stats that give extra bonuses, like Reload Speed, Skill Recovery Speed, Fire Rate, Ammo Capacity, and more! This helps you customize your gameplay and gives you some extra fighting power.

Get ready to try the different weapons out for yourself in the next Closed Beta! Sign up on the Relic Hunters Steam Page ! We look forward to seeing you in-game as we take on the Ducans!

Cheers ~

notes.content:
We are so excited for everyone to jump into Relic Hunters Legend’s Closed Beta on [b]May 18th at 9AM CT, until May 22nd at 9AM CT May 18[/b]!  

This Closed Beta is bringing a bunch of new things for you to experience into the game! 
[list]
[*] More Story Adventures! Play through a brand-new act with your favorite Hunters.
[*] New Items to help you on your missions! 
[*] Face stronger foes! Enemies levels 20 to 30 are waiting!
[*] Find new Tier 3 Gear and Weapons!
[*] Trade gear and items with your fellow Hunters! 
[*] Hunter level cap has been increased to 25!
[*] Max Rebel Rank increased to 10!
[*] Total Skill Points have been increased to 32!
[/list]

In addition, the progress for players that joined the Closed Beta: Stress Test will be kept for this Closed Beta.  

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES [/h2]
This is an in-development build of Relic Hunters Legend, so you may encounter some issues while you play. Below are some of the known issues you may encounter: 
[list]
[*] Some performance issues during missions.
[*] Red Chests and Resources are missing in some regions. This could impact certain Feats/Rebel Ranks but there will be plenty of loot available, nonetheless.
[*] The portal will occasionally not be visible to players in multiplayer missions. This has been seen to occur if the Host is playing a Special Mission that has expired for the person joining.
[*] Players can occasionally get trapped between props on different maps.
[*] Some props on Secret Market have no collision.
[*] Players can get stuck in specific areas on different missions.
[*] Players might not be able to remove selected items from the trade screen. This should correct when the player backs out of the trade.
[*] Trading may show an error and not complete if players unequip items at the Secret Market and try to trade them.
[*] If players perform Transfer or Enhance actions on items while in the Secret Market, an error will occur and enhancements won't show if the item is then Traded to another player.
[*] Note: Rebel Rank 1 is required to trade items in the Secret Market. This is intentional and will be made more obvious in the future.
[*] The Gamepad pointer may stick on the screen after a trade is completed using a gamepad.
[*] Some localized texts might not be written with the official fonts because of some special characters ( like the "ç" or "ã" in Portuguese, for example).
[/list]

If you find bugs that aren't on this list, you can report them using the steps below! Thank you so much for being a part of our community, Hunter! ⭐ 
[h2]
REPORTING BUGS 
[/h2]
[h3]
In-Game Bug Reporter 
[/h3]
If you encounter any issues while playing, there’s a handy built-in bug-reporting tool!  
To access it, hit F3 on your keyboard. This will automatically take a screenshot and attach it to your report, so our team knows where the issue happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/36e3cb4f150e40d59dc86316adf7b4aee12f338a.png[/img]

Next, fill out the Description text box with:
[list][*]What you were doing when the issue arose 
[*]What the issue (bug) was 
[*]Where you found it 
[/list]
For instance, if the audio suddenly cut out while playing in the Galyno Canyon stage, you could hit F3 and write:
[i]
While playing in the Galyno Canyon stage with my party, the sound of the weapons disappeared right after I switched weapons and didn’t come back”.
[/i]
Please feel free to report any bugs you encounter, no matter how simple they may seem. Each bug report is valuable information for our team and helps us make [i]Relic Hunters Legend[/i] even better! 

Thanks again for helping us test the servers for this closed beta.

The weapon Strider has no sound effects 
[*]
Gear and weapons sometimes lose level upgrades when leaving the Character Menu 
[*]
The game sometimes crashes when exiting 
[*]
The gear score bar does not display the correct gear score rank after transitioning to any location 
[/list]
If you find bugs that aren't on this list, you can report them using the steps below! Thank you so much for being a part of our community, Hunter! ⭐ 
[h2]
REPORTING BUGS 
[/h2]
[h3]
In-Game Bug Reporter 
[/h3]
If you encounter any issues while playing, there’s a handy built-in bug-reporting tool!  
To access it, hit F3 on your keyboard. This will automatically take a screenshot and attach it to your report, so our team knows where the issue happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/36e3cb4f150e40d59dc86316adf7b4aee12f338a.png[/img]

Next, fill out the Description text box with:
[list][*]What you were doing when the issue arose 
[*]What the issue (bug) was 
[*]Where you found it 
[/list]
For instance, if the audio suddenly cut out while playing in the Galyno Canyon stage, you could hit F3 and write:
[i]
While playing in the Galyno Canyon stage with my party, the sound of the weapons disappeared right after I switched weapons and didn’t come back”.
[/i]
Please feel free to report any bugs you encounter, no matter how simple they may seem. Each bug report is valuable information for our team and helps us make Relic Hunters Legend even better! 

[h3]
Reporting on [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Discord[/url] 
[/h3]
While the in-game reporter is the best way to report issues, if you are having persistent problems and need help you can also report bugs in the [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Discord[/url] [b]#bug-report[/b] channel. You can also always browse the [b]#known-issues[/b] channel for common problems and solutions. 
For all reports in [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Discord[/url], please tag the issue with one of the following categories:
[list]
[b]Critical:[/b] Any bug or issue that prevents you from accessing a core gameplay feature. 
[list][*][i]Examples: A specific skill doesn’t work, UI doesn’t display, consistent crashes from an activity.[/i][/list]
[b]Blocker:[/b] Any issue that prevents you from progressing through the game or leveling up. 
[list][*][i]Examples: XP not increasing, Getting repeatedly kicked out of a mission.[/i][/list]
[b]Major:[/b] Anything that affects gameplay but does not break the feature entirely. 
[list][*][i]Example: A skill has a wrong buff/debuff value; Some weapons have no firing sound.[/i][/list]
[b]Minor:[/b] Issues that do not affect gameplay. 
[list][*][i]Example: Clipping issues, Typos, Visual Bugs.[/i][/list][/list]

Let the team know: what happened, how it happened, where it happened, and whether it was a one-off or consistent issue (i.e. does it always happen this same way in this same place?). 

Our support staff will then do their best to help you (and others) who are having issues playing. 

Thanks again for helping us test the servers for this closed beta.

notes.title: CLOSED BETA: STRESS TEST ANNOUNCE POST & FAQ
notes.content:
Hello Hunters! 
We are very excited to announce that the Relic Hunters Legend Closed Beta: Stress Test is finally upon us! 🎉🎉 We will start opening access to players on a rolling basis starting [b]10am ET April 13[/b], until [b]10pm ET April 16[/b]. (Make sure to check spam filters for your invite!)

We want you to be as informed as possible when you jump into Relic Hunters Legend for the first time, so we’ve put together some quick questions and explanations of what to expect! 

[h1]How to Access the Closed Beta: Stress Test [/h1]
You (and your friends) can still sign-up for this Closed Beta even after it has started. Request access through the Steam Store Page by clicking on the 🟩 green button 🟩! This will put you in the queue to receive access! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/bd9b0b987c7eb1b5e7cd0dde112aa46c62772278.png[/img]

[h2]Then What?[/h2]

There are limited spots available for this Closed Beta. If you get in, ✨ thank you for joining✨! When you’ve been accepted, you'll receive an email to the account registered to Steam letting you know you can now download Relic Hunters Legend on the Store Page!
For this beta, we are testing core systems and server capacity. We also want to know what you think, so we’ll send out a survey after the Closed Beta: Stress Test ends. Make sure you complete the survey so all your feedback is captured!

[h1]Relic Hunters Legend Closed Beta: Stress Test FAQ[/h1]

[b]What languages will be available?[/b]

Relic Hunters Legend will be available in: English and Brazilian Portuguese. Subtitles are available in Polish, Italian, Korean, Latin American Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, French, and German. 

[b]Can I Stream/Create Content For/Post About the Closed Beta: Stress Test?[/b]
Yes, you can share, record, and stream the game! Not all the features for launch will be available in this Closed Beta, and some aspects of the game could change between future tests and launch. 
We encourage you to play now, stream now, enjoy the game with your communities, send feedback over, and keep your eyes open for the next test to see what’s new!

[b]Where can I get information on Game Status?[/b]
For critical issues, such as server outages and game-breaking bugs, the team will be posting status updates on [url=https://twitter.com/RelicHuntersU]Twitter[/url], Weibo, and in the [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Discord[/url].

[b]What if something goes wrong?[/b]
For direct communication, we have Community Managers and (super helpful) fellow Hunters in the [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Closed Beta Discord Channels[/url]. We have channels for Hunters looking for groups, sharing feedback, and reporting bugs. If you’re ever lost, someone is around to help! These channels each have their own guidelines, so help us help you by following the rules of the Discord!

Players can also report bugs, issues, and submit feedback to [url=https://support.gearboxsoftware.com/hc/en-us/categories/10169194574349-Relic-Hunters-Legend]support.gearbox.com[/url]. Please provide a description of your problem and any images as needed for the Customer Support Team to help you! 

[b]I Need to Report a Player![/b]
Relic Hunters Legends was created with the building of a positive, inclusive community of players as a top priority! If you see a player that is breaking chat rules, being disruptive, or causing issues, you’re able to discreetly report them using Mod Mail in the [url=https://discord.gg/relichunters]Relic Hunters Discord[/url]. The Moderators will be able to review the report and act as needed.

Violators of the Community Guidelines are subject to disciplinary actions that can include immediate removal from this Closed Beta, removal from all subsequent Closed Betas, an indefinite loss of in-game chat privileges, and a permanent ban from the Relic Hunters Legends Discord.

If you feel a Moderator is acting outside of their role or abusing their permissions, contact a Community Manager with relevant information so they can review the case.

[b]What do I have to look forward to after this Closed Beta?[/b]
After the Closed Beta: Stress Test, we will have a link to a survey where you can answer questions about your experience. 

We will have more to come this year, including tests covering things like End Game, Trading, and more leading up to the eventual release of Early Access! Make sure to follow Relic Hunters on Social Channels for news, announcements, and updates about this test and future information!

Thank you so much for participating! We can’t wait to see you in-game and in the community!

Discord: https://discord.gg/relichunters
Twitter: https://twitter.com/RelicHuntersU
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RelicHuntersUniverse/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playrelichunters

Thank you so much for participating! We can’t wait to see you in-game and in the community!
