notes.title: November Dev Blog
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, how have you been?

In November, we’ve continued to improve, fix and create new features for the game, and you can check all of that below!

We have also figured out what causes the aim bug that detracts from the overall game experience. We've been working tirelessly to fix it to be able to release the new build for our backers and founders, but it's a much bigger problem than we'd like it to be. It was caused by a Unity update instead of our own code, so we are doing some reverse engineering to figure out how to fix it. We’ll keep you updated about it in our channels.

So without further ado, let’s check out the news:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/10a0514e208914912b404c85e5c33f526489e85c.png[/img]

[h1]Multi-Adventure Tracking[/h1]

Now you’re able to track four Adventures and Side Adventures at the same time and it’ll be listed on the right side of the screen. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jDVWkar7zD2hFsvTEZ/giphy.gif[/img]

We also implemented track icons in the Map Screen, so you can easily find the right mission to complete the quests on the world map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/95c6f240a77815687758f408da12098376f566e3.png[/img]

[h1]Auto-Advance: Story[/h1]

We created a new tool that will advance the cutscenes and dialogues automatically, so you don’t need to click to progress in the story. You can also Enable or Disable the Auto Advance whenever you want to by clicking “H” or going to the main options and selecting it. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/yApn6BxepSVH0cm9M5/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]First Pass - New Game Mode: Rift[/h1]

This new game mode will be only available in Act 2, so our early access players won’t be able to play it until the release. But we’re going to spoil just a lil’ bit here (visual feedbacks are placeholder):

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3IoGykCUR04gsBjzGm/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

Our goal with Rift was to create a game mode where Tank builds would be valuable. We wanted to avoid having another “DPS race” mode, and we are quite proud of the design we came up with for Rift.

The main objective of this game mode is to collect time orbs by defeating enemies and releasing the orbs at the Rifts to close them. The catch on this game mode, and why it’s a hard one, is that each Orb you’re carrying increases by 10% of all damage you take. So now would be a great time to care for your tank friends huh?

Also, if you die when you’re carrying orbs, you’ll lose all of them and it’ll affect item bonuses that you can get by closing the portals. Normal mode doesn't have a fail state, but on Hard, you’ll have a couple of lives and if you lose them you’ll lose the game as a party. Also, if your party loses too many orbs, two immortal mini-bosses will show up to prevent you from closing the portal. 

It’s just a first pass, there's still a lot to do and test to finish this new game mode, but we wanted to share this news with you!

[h1]New Music and SFX[/h1]

With all the new story missions and adventures, we would need some new music and sound effects, right? So we've made [b]A LOT[/b] of them and we're sure you'll love the new Relic Hunters Legend soundtrack.

[h1]New VFX and Props animations[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/akYuKayrWk4iUBv6Os/giphy.gif[/img]

To make your immersion and experience with our game even more interesting, we've started to add more animations to our props and create new VFXs on skills and object details. You’re going to have a surprise when you play it for the first time! 

[h1]New Multiplayer Missions[/h1]

We also created new Missions, so you’ll have new experiences and places to explore and find out the best strategies to overcome the challenges that you’ll face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/c137a4d63b66963e1b5896b0e3877e808631252c.png[/img]

[h1]New enemies[/h1]

In our last update, we talked about the mysterious third enemy faction, which we are not going to spoil. But enemy variety is very important, so we are not done yet!! We're developing new Ducan and Kami enemies, even stronger and more fearless than you've ever seen, take a look:

[h2]Ducan Imperial Guard[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d0c76c975152649215a2eca3645a3d9df9753793.png[/img]

Inspired by the first concepts that we had back in 2018 of how the Ducan army would look like, we’re now creating the Ducan Imperial Guard, which you’ll encounter in Act 3. This one is just a sneak peek of what we’re preparing for you.

[h2]Kami Spit[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rgfCjUtCihaRKOECZd/giphy.gif[/img]

We already talked about the new Kami species that we were developing and now we finished implementing the Kami Spit! It has an unique behavior and is going to spit some venomous drool on you. The battle against it is going to be messy… and quite disgusting.

[h1]Mass Recycle & Auto Recycle[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/2gYyEXn68FbMMJDjXd/giphy.gif[/img]

This was something our early access players were asking for a lot: Mass Recycle. You will now be able to configure which type of items you want to recycle and just press a single big green button to dispose of them all!

Using the same kind of filters, you can also set up the Auto-Recycle: items meeting the criteria will be automatically converted to Materials when you pick them up. No more clicking on each of the rags you dropped on the missions, yay!

After the game is released, we plan to keep improving these tools to turn them into actual “Item Filters” that you’d find in ARPGs such as Path of Exile or Grim Dawn, allowing you to filter not only by rarity and type but also by affix type, rolls, etc.

[h1]Raff’s Gear Score Outfits[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/6d931ccc4fb1baab93dd549e955f157943360cef.png[/img]

How could we forget to give stylish clothes to the most stylish Hunter in the galaxy? That's right, now Raff will parade in style with her new Gear Score outfits. She’s getting cooler and cooler every time.

[h1]New Water Shaders[/h1]

We know that details make all the difference in the experience you have with the stories and games we make. With that in mind, we’re implementing new Shaders that give that extra boost to the look of our levels and make the game look even more beautiful. Today we have Seawater, Rivers, Lakes, and Fountain Shaders working! Look at how cool this beach is!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5t16GgAVcqB2WQk6rZ/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]More props and assets[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/aad8fb68932105c64fe8216fbe76e30b90198d96.png[/img]

Well, this is something we never get tired of. We kept developing new assets that will compose the scenarios in the missions of the second and third acts. Each of these assets will be useful for future set dressing that we’ll need to do, so every work effort on it is priceless!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/7a35975e9aae918d4c95f8c6fd0dc5cfc82caea1.png[/img]

[h1]New Adventure Covers[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/fbb53d7a6042806f1193e2a9cb797e2d2c18a5b1.png[/img]

New Adventures means new Adventure Covers too! We've created almost every card that will appear in your Journal for Acts 2 and 3, adding a special touch to each quest you choose to complete. As a bonus, we've got some amazing wallpapers to share with you in the future.

[h1]Semilla City: Background[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/37f6f6e7a4abd86477f5955ec405d2871afe3270.png[/img]

So as you already know from the past updates, we were developing missions in the fanciest place in the galaxy: Semilla City. For that, we also needed to make a new background so that your experience with it was complete. You’ll be on cloud nine in this city ~


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d3841acb4441c7075109a5ba88ea7264e9ca01f9.png[/img]

[h1]Inventory Screen Improvements[/h1]

In the last update, we showcased the first pass in the inventory screen and we kept polishing and improving it. Now it’s easier to find materials to enhance your equipment.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/AlIZgV0f4VGleeoJxr/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Story & Game Design[/h1]

Our Game Designers also worked a lot in polishing the experience with all the adventures, from acts one to three, and now we’re sure that you’ll have the best time playing all the quests that you’ll face in the game.

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

Well, as it's not always a bed of roses, with all the new features we made, a lot of new (and some old) bugs showed up. Our QA team is doing their best to track down all the bugs and help find a solution to fix them. Some bugs that we have already tracked and fixed this month are:


[list]
[*] At the end of a Payload round, the cartwheels don't spin without stopping.
[*] Some VOs were being called at the wrong time during the beginning of the missions.
[*] The last chest destroyed at the Defense mode before going into Teleport Round mode could be opened by the player.
[*] Drop-in in mid-game in Defense mode gave black screen of death
[*] Gatecrashers weren't dropping loot
[*] In Distraction game mode: The COTB increased the penalty as the round progressed.
[*] Defense and Distraction Chest did not drop loot for players who dropped in mid-game
[*] Charge Captain didn't do damage
[/list]

That’s it for November, there's a lot of news to come and we'll keep you updated on all of our channels. Join our Discord to share your thoughts on what you think about everything we share here and spend quality time with us and our amazing community there!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]

Cheers ~

notes.title: October Development Blog
notes.content:
During October we focused on “tidying up the house”, polishing the game and fixing several bugs that came up during the last few months. Not everything turned out as expected, but we’re still working hard and we’re focused on providing the best experience possible for our players.

The new build for the founders is very close to being deployed. We hope you enjoy the news to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/10a0514e208914912b404c85e5c33f526489e85c.png[/img]

[h1]New Faction Enemies[/h1]

We kept improving and creating different enemies for the new enemy Faction that you will meet in Act 2 of Relic Hunters Legend. You already know that we’re not going to spoil them, but we already have five new enemies done for this mysterious new faction.

Take a look at this new melee weapon that some of these enemies will use against our Relic Hunters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f54baabfad988356d1de49f84bf3ffbe9ba56e97.png[/img]

Pretty cool huh?! How do you think they’ll use it? 

[h1]Ducan Flamebeak: Lava Floor[/h1]

The new faction aren't the only new enemies that will show up in Relic Hunters Legend. We’re finishing the implementation of the [b]Ducan bosses[/b] that our players will face during their journey. One of them is [b]Captain Flamebeak[/b]! We talked a little about him in the last Dev Blog, but we kept adding unique features to the fight, like the Lava floor! Still needs some adjustments, but it’s looking pretty cool already. 

Never has a battle in Relic Hunters Legend been this hot! Glad I was using cheats while recording the GIF and taking 0 damage :p

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/gXI3P3gKnMrZVxE3QA/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h1]More maps and props[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/a63e324d6a490a60e8c16d7d7c1b260ff86a1082.png[/img]

Along with the development of Acts 2 and 3 of the main Story, we kept creating more maps and props to compose these new scenarios. Our 3D art team is taking care of every single detail to enhance your experience and immersion in the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/712e53e412e74b3cfe27d7600d46e50321998ef1.png[/img]

[h1]Map Nodes[/h1]

New maps and missions come with new Map Nodes that are going to be viewed on the Galaxy Map. The next Acts of the game will open up more places on the Cradle for our players to explore! Take a look at the first pass for some of these new nodes we’ll have:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/c615edc5d8e3ccc9c3611464b15ebc67bde4380b.png[/img]

[h1]New NPCs[/h1]

As the story unfolds, it’s also necessary to develop and implement the new NPCs that you will meet. We designed and animated a bunch of them this month and you can check one of them here! Some NPCs are pretty cool and others are nasty and evil, but you’ll judge it by yourself when you encounter them.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/nJsirkoEmH1vEiLiyI/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Ace Gear Score Skins[/h1]

Jimmy and Pinkyy have already become the cool kids and now it’s Ace’s turn to get stylish! Now whenever you reach a new Gear Score Rank (such as Common I or Rare I) you will get a visual upgrade for Ace too. Nice and tidy and ready to track down some shiny Relics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/0c1682817bf66243f04e8dcc579c039e220da71a.png[/img]

[h1]Inventory[/h1]

We are working on an inventory screen for you to check out and organize all of your currencies and materials. We’re still tweaking some stuff on this screen, but it’s already working in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/6732173d5174754313b92aa6b915545e5700aad2.png[/img]

[h1]Item Favorite[/h1]

Now you can mark Gear and Weapons in your backpack or storage as “Favorite”, protecting them against being Recycled. No more accidentally breaking your favorite weapon, yay!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YaTGA5xgGs1YfVW2Cz/giphy.gif[/img]~

[h1]First Pass: Stats Screen[/h1]

We are working on a new Stats Screen so you can see detailed RPG stats for your Hunter and their gear. Again, It still needs some polish and improvements, but it’s a first pass and is already in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/a3b39c6e0702db117ccd3db5e9586c78ba8e904e.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d3841acb4441c7075109a5ba88ea7264e9ca01f9.png[/img]

[h1]Game Modes[/h1]

In previous Dev Blog updates we have shown you our upcoming Game Modes. We kept improving the experience, implementing new visual feedback, adjusting the gameplay and fixing a lot of bugs that show up on the way. So check it out:

[h2]Distraction Mode[/h2]
New visual feedback: progress bar with fire vfx, new radial bar, megaphone icon, and more.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/0PXV82z9Pbr3qGgR3x/giphy.gif[/img]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xnEd4BakxUbwOcp34X/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Bugfix: [/b]
[list]
[*] Edge tracking fixed
[*] Story rounds now can be added
[*] Reward is appearing correctly
[*] Adjustment on the announcements
[/list]

[h2]Defense Mode[/h2]

[list]
[*] Desert Hideout lanes fixed
[*] Added VFX and death/explosion animation when Gatecrasher self-destroys
[*] Added announcement for "Get Ready" at the beginning of the first round of Defense
[/list]

[b]Bugfix: [/b]
[list]
[*] Open/closed Gatecrasher animations have been fixed and display at correct time
[*] Chests will no longer erroneously appear with an X for drop-in remote clients
[*] Megaphone icon no longer appear in the Gatecrasher
[/list]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BOj2qozhLHAGmTYY1f/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h2]Delve Mode[/h2]

[b]Bugfix: [/b]
[list]
[*]Mission objective is now correctly updated for remote clients after drop-in
[/list]

[h1]New Position for Loot[/h1]

We have moved the loot interface to the middle of the screen. This makes loot easier to see, but most importantly will free up space on the right side of the interface for one of our most requested features yet: multi-quest tracking! Coming Soon™.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d163d5d9e09ed173d06074ce14cec200f81ac649.png[/img]

[h1]Tons of Bug fixes[/h1]

As we implemented and created several new features, many bugs appeared along the way. Some were easy to solve and others not so much. We planned to deploy an update for our founders to play this month, but a major bug in the weapon aim appeared and we need to fix it before releasing it for everyone. But don’t worry, we’re already addressing it and soon our alpha players will be able to experience a lot more content than they have ever see!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]

There are many more things to come, so stay tuned for new updates! Keep following us on social media, join our Discord Channel to hang out with us and ask your questions about Relic Hunters - we’re always there to assist you and our community loves to make new friends. 

Thanks for reading and supporting our journey so far.

Cheers ~

notes.title: September Development Blog
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, how have you been?

September had a lot of polish, improvements, and quite a few new things to be implemented in Relic Hunters Legend. We’re close to having the new alpha build ready for you to play and give us feedback about everything we have made so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/10a0514e208914912b404c85e5c33f526489e85c.png[/img]

[h1]New enemy faction implemented [/h1]

We’re not going to spoil who these new enemies are, but we’ll let you take a peek at one of their new abilities. We want you to discover strategies to defeat these enemies by yourselves when the game is fully released.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UkeKxi5xXBkOkz2fWw/giphy.gif[/img]

So, now we have in our system the possibility of grenades and abilities to pulse damage when activated and other fighting styles have been added to enhance the experience and the challenges that our players will face in Relic Hunters Legend.

This Faction also brings new weapons for you to collect! Take a look at this faction weapon design:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/7e6df65cb015f36bc95b2b69c66e0dc480fa1b44.png[/img]

[h1]Kami Nari and new projectile behaviors[/h1]

Kami Nari is the new Electric/Magnetic Kami species and we added new projectile parameters for their attacks. We are now able to create more complex behaviors with bullets, such as this “zig-zag” pattern!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3bG83oJTLpPZS5NHoL/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h1]The Gatecrashers[/h1]

We finished developing the Defense Game Mode (we explained how this game mode works on the June Dev Blog), but we still had to design and implement the Ducan Gatecrasher and the Kami Boom - the enemies that summon waves of enemies and destroy your precious chests.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YAQSeMnMD9DWTqFoIT/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Gear Score Rank Outfits for Jimmy![/h1]

We’re creating Jimmy’s Gear Score outfits - clearly Pinkyy is not the only one with style in this team! You’ll unlock these new cosmetic outfits as you level up and enhance the character’s Gear Score with powerful equipment and weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/617520e9294cf99f0844685958bee882191f3133.png[/img]

[h1]Second Act Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/b0da8eb24541892af28d356bd04f907a6569de1d.png[/img]

We already said that we’re working on the Second Act of the game and to make it happen we’re adding more maps, scenarios, missions, and NPCs. So by launch, our players will have tons of new places to explore, characters to meet, and stories to be revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/683813e297b2ab48c02c5b03c2fa0d17da00fc45.png[/img]

Some of the new NPCs have a lot of personality and we’re super excited for you to meet them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/54da5c9f7af4bf63abf61dcebb92e62f53076fdf.png[/img]

[h1]New VFX and Animations for bosses[/h1]

We have some new bosses coming up and they have new animations and VFX. This one is Captain Flamebeak that you face on the Delve Game Mode. He’ll keep things heated on the battlefield.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/OqiF4VW6Zkj7lmrWEn/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]New Design for Semilla City[/h1]

Along with the development of the new missions and maps for Act Two, we realized that our old concept for Semilla City didn't quite fit the current art direction, and it wasn't very clear that there was an entire city within it. So we decided to change it and now we’re happy with how it looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f3bcc291073ffbc08368f5a03b5797e7c8d7a26e.jpg[/img]
[i]Old Semilla City[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/0d965279bf57076ba7af3bc95799db51e7b0cd8d.png[/img]
[i]New Semilla City[/i]

[h1]New props and assets[/h1]

We kept improving the environments in all the maps and missions, creating new assets and props that will make your experience with the game more fun and immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/78c36648ff102c9f95c766a9b60a874df4216bae.png[/img]

[h1]New Animated Cutscenes underway[/h1]

We finished the first pass of the new cutscenes that are going to be in Act Two and Act Three and we’re working on recording the new VO’s, creating the scenes and animations, editing the videos, and so on. How excited are you to see what’s next? 

[h1]New sound effects and Music[/h1]

With all these new features being implemented of course we’ll need more sound effects and Music. This month our Sound Designers worked on:


[list]
[*] Music for Semilla City 
[*] Music for Hilltown
[*] SFX for the Chat 3.0 system
[*] Sounds for the new enemy faction (characters and weapons)
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d3841acb4441c7075109a5ba88ea7264e9ca01f9.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements and polish on new Game Modes: Delve, Defense, and Distraction[/h1]

We talked about all these new Game Modes in the previous updates, but we kept working on improving and polishing them, so take a look at what we did for them this month:

[h2]Distraction Mode[/h2]

[list]
[*] New announcements and feedback for edge tracking and VFX
[*] Fixing Blocker and Critical bugs
[*] Multiplayer Sync
[*] Fixed Chests at the end of the round
[*] New visual feedbacks and icons
[/list]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lY60R2NZvknXw48kov/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h2]Defense[/h2]

[list]
[*] Hard and Epic mode implemented
[*] Multiplayer is working
[*] Gatecrashers: Receives heal when the team wipes; Implemented the death animation; Rewards when defeated
[*] Rounds working smoothly
[*] Refactor on team wipe and lose and win condition
[*] Bug fixes from the QA playtest
[*] New VFX and UI
[/list]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l9AIPoCMPDO6OUZDtk/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]Delve[/h2]

[list]
[*] Implemented Hard mode
[*] Delve key working 
[*] Multiplayer working
[/list]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LSDnhOn9J4xAQDI5k4/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]The second Act of the Story is fully implemented[/h1]

We finished implementing the second act of the Story and now we’re focused on reviewing and editing possible parts to better fit the player experience with our story. Alpha players will not be able to test this part of the game, but we guarantee that we are taking care of all the details to make this story exciting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/190f62ba97954b89e31e66694fb24e5f817964b0.png[/img]

[h1]Map and Missions improvements[/h1]

We've also revisited all our previous mission maps to improve and better adapt them to our game style. As an example, we've increased Desert Hideout's access areas, filling in the gaps that previously existed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/59ed58d349a06d83dcdeec37b60c75aa6bdef92b.png[/img]
[i]Desert Hideout Before[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/7df3a4b18f12f83bd36fa7e4d8e9a82c1df6c204.png[/img]
[i]Desert Hideout After[/i]


We also changed the pacing of some missions and how some maps were allocated on the Cradle:

[list]
[*] Desert Hideout is on the way to Peaks Blockade
[*] Galyno Desert is now between Red Mouth Hills and Ducan Desert Outpost
[*] To Mend a Broken Spaceheart (Adventure) only unlocks after you made the Relic Hunting 101
[*] No Man’s Land from Lv. 1/2/6 to Lv. 2/3/6
[*] Desert Hideout from Lv. 5 to Lv. 4
[*] Desert Outpost from Lv. 6 to Lv. 5
[*] Galyno Desert from Lv. 4/5/9 to Lv. 8/9/11
[/list]

[h1]IA improvements & fix[/h1]

We improved and fixed some of our IA behaviors and we improved their efficiency on the System to avoid new problems


[h1]Chat 3.0 [/h1]

[list]
[*] Tutorial improvements
[*] Audio fixes
[*] UX improvements:
[*] Party as the main channel
[*] Focus on the whisper tab when the player receives a message
[*] Bigger chat list for whisper tab
[*] Previous chat 100% removed from the game
[/list]

[h1]Option page[/h1]

[list]
[*] Working 100% on controllers
[*] Redoing key rebinding
[/list]

[h1]New Party System [/h1]
[list]
[*] Transitions, Drop-In (Done)
[*] Kick, Promote (Done)
[*] Party Merge (In progress)
[*] Party Away (In progress)
[/list]

All these new things came with a lot of new bugs that we needed to fix too (game development is hard :( ) but we tested out with the whole Rogue Snail team and we managed to fix most of them. We’ll continue to polish and improve the game until we launch for everyone.

Our new Alpha Players update is really close, probably in October we’ll be able to deploy it for our founders and backers to play and give us feedback, we’ll keep you updated about it here and on our Discord Community!

[url=http://discord.gg/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]

Thanks for reading and supporting our journey so far.

Cheers ~

notes.title: August Developments Blog
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, how are you doing?

August was a pretty awesome month for us, we celebrate the 6 years of our Relic Hunters franchise and with all of your help, we accomplished 100k wishlists for Legend. We couldn’t be happier about it. And of course, we kept working pretty hard to develop even more features and stories for you to enjoy in Relic Hunters Legend. 

We’re also celebrating these achievements with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/2970674116339058481]Celebration Weapon Contest[/url], so if you want to get a chance to win [b]two Relic Hunters Legend Alpha Key[/b], check what you need to do and the rules of the contest to participate in the previous Steam News! [i](the event will roll out until 05th September)[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/2970674116339058481][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/9c98d09bbf1e9b74a7db8fb93df18fe946d78555.png[/img][/url]

So with no more further ado, check out the things we’ve been working on in August for the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/10a0514e208914912b404c85e5c33f526489e85c.png[/img]

[h1]New Map and Assets[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/4b7ecbed09c1cd49c663ac62a140d39d3bb91042.jpg[/img]

More maps for you to enjoy! These are some prompts for Ubabela, the most prosperous touristic city around the Oasis, the last remnant “ocean” in the Cradle. Will be the hunters able to relax and drink coconut water on the beach or will be a lot of trouble waiting for them in this paradisiac place? Well, you’ll have to discover it by yourself in the second Act of the Relic Hunters Legend story when the game launches! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f765a282fe9caeb2d5ac79cdb14693e8c2f339f2.png[/img]


We also kept modeling and implementing some pretty fancy buildings and other cool assets for Semilla City, the richest place in the Galaxy, where all the elite members of the Duke Ducan Empire live.


[h1]Second Act of the Story (Main and Side Adventures)[/h1]

We’re working on the Second Act of the story in Relic Hunters Legend, the script is done and now we’re implementing the dialogs and adventures in the game.

These adventures and features will not be available for our alpha players to play until launch, but will be worth the wait!


[h1]New Kami Species Implemented[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kqGHTMWKyJaa7yQciz/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611de838c68f440278277cad6e6d52ea71e4603639d&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

We implemented some of the new species of Kamis that we’ll have in Relic Hunters Legend. With new behaviors, attacks, and visual and sound effects, you’ll be shocked to face them!

[h1]Pinkyy’s Rarity Icons[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/350205bf780a366cfffe1cf77e129ec9ca48b9e8.png[/img]

We had already implemented Pinkyy's new cosmetics, but we needed to make their icons too, so now she has it all! We can't wait to see how everyone will combine these cosmetics and improve Pinkyy's style.

[h1]Chat 3.0[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/u8ptmjIq5RUjWIJzXr/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611997d1b539ecbef44999e7065a53e0c911949ae97&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

We tested our previous chat and we realized that it needed some changes, so we developed and implement Chat 3.0:

[list]
[*] Now every tab has icons and the label will appear only when selected.
[*] Party and Whisper tab will open when you receive a message, except when the input is focused
[*] Chat sounds only trigger when the tab is open
[*] Announce System implemented: now we have announces when the player enters or leave the party and when they receive a Heart or Super Heart
[*] Help button pop-up
[/list]

[h1]New Music and SFX[/h1]

With all the new maps and stories being implemented, of course, we’ll have new Music and Sound Effects too! We’re not going to reveal it for you now, but you’ll have a great surprise with the Legend’s soundtracks. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d3841acb4441c7075109a5ba88ea7264e9ca01f9.png[/img]

[h1]Delve, Defense and Distraction Game Mode Improvements and Bug fixing[/h1]

We talked about these game modes in the June and July Dev Blog and we kept improving the experience with them this month. For Defense and Distraction, we finished implementing the game modes in the normal mode and started to make the missions on Hard and Epic. We also made some bug fixes that were discovered in our playtests.

In Delve we’re making the polishment to enhance the experience with this game mode. To access this game mode, the player needs to have a Delve key that they’ll be able to get from Special Missions and the Mission Requirement System is already implemented.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lkSEStFngCdHRUOeMq/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Dialog Typos[/h1]

We revised all the dialogs and fixes some minor typos that we discovered.


[h1]Streamlined Dialogs and Side Adventures Dialog Options[/h1]

We kept working on streamlining all the dialogs in Relic Hunters Legend and we also included dialog options in the Side Adventures.
[h1]Improvements in the Ambient Profile[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/dbfb085695ec5087a0a9fd501a5e4cb04732fda0.png[/img]

We improved the settings in our Ambient Profile and now the shadows, daylight, and nightlight are looking so much better now.

[h1]Party System Improvements[/h1]

We created a system that will prevent the player from leaving their party if they start a Story Mission to complete an Adventure. This system still needs some polishment but is already in the game.

[h1]Pause Function Improvements[/h1]

As we talked about in the previous developments blog, now you can pause the game when playing solo. We tested this function a lot and kept improving the experience with it this month.


[h1]Shader Improvements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/525a6b7ae3803a6cf65c9e41e5442e011c1ec69b.png[/img]

We developed a shader for the vegetation and assets sway and we’re also working on new shaders to make our environments more interactive and beautiful to improve the immersion in our game.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

We tested out a lot of the new features that we’re implementing in the game and this month we fixed some bugs in the Compare System, Chat, Bubble Chat, Options, and UX Gamepad. (We talked about them in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/633080/view/2986435084320030420]previous dev blog[/url])

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/PZtXCTvbRsB74p9Z0l/giphy.gif[/img]

There were also some Bug fixes that came from the feedback of our community playtest that we already addressed and fix, such as:
[list]
[*] Backpack potion in front of the Back Button
[*] Leave Party Button Fixed
[*] Seven Passive ability Fixed - it was triggering at the very beginning of the game and now it’s fixed
[*] AutoEquip: Fixed the UI and the network operation and we also fixed the equip item notification appearing when the item has already been automatically equipped.
[*] Removed the Gameplay jingle when closing the game
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/3e128f41eecd8965e62be6ed34e94c448f83f2a6.png[/img]

And there are many more things to come! Keep following us on social media, join our Discord Channel to hang out with us, and ask your questions about Relic Hunters - we’re always there to assist you and our community loves to make new friends.

Cheers,
[i]Rogue Snail Team[/i]

[url=http://discord.gg/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Celebration Weapon Contest!
notes.content:
August is a very special month to us and we want to keep celebrating all the goals we have reached so far with the Relic Hunters franchise! We’re working extra hard alongside our Mysterious Strangers to deliver Relic Hunters Legend the way we always dreamed of. 

During our last livestream, we could see how much all of you are excited to play Relic Hunters Legend earlier, so we thought that the previous giveaway wasn’t enough and we’ll give you another chance to grab a Steam Alpha Key for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/9c98d09bbf1e9b74a7db8fb93df18fe946d78555.png[/img]

In this event, you’ll have to create your own concept for a Relic Hunters Legend’s weapon with the theme: [b]Celebration[/b]!

You can use your [b]imagination[/b]! Will it shoot glitter? Will it have a party hat as the trigger? It is up to you!

[h1]To participate you’ll need to:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Draw the concept - you can make it digitally or manually
[*] Create the name for your weapon
[*] Make a small description of its function
[*] Send it all to the channel [b]#celebration-weapon [/b]in our Discord Server
[/list]
We’ll be accepting submissions until [b]September 05th, at 11 PM BRT (GMT-3)[/b] and the winners will be announced on [b]September 07th[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/5ba8ea547b212afd2b154ba8af3b4d826fb3b814.png[/img]

The Rogue Snail team will choose the [b]6 best concepts[/b] to award the players with [b]2 Alpha keys[/b] each, so they can play together with their friends!

And remember: you don’t need to be a master gun designer, we’re seeking [b]great[/b],[b] fun[/b], and [b]silly[/b] concepts for this contest! So just use your [i]~~imagination~~[/i] and participate!

[h1]Rules:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Don’t[/b] make any NSFW or offensive references in your concept
[*] Submit [b]both[/b] a draw and a description for your celebratory weapon. Only the draw or the description will not count as a submission.
[*] You can send [b]as many ideas as you like[/b], there is no application limit
[*] Submissions will be accepted until [b]September 05th, at 11 PM BRT (GMT-3)[/b]. Submissions made after that will not be considered
[*] Only submissions made at the [b]Discord channel #celebration-weapon[/b] will be accepted
[/list]
Participate and show us what you got!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]

Cheers,
Lucy Guerrero
[i]Rogue Snail, Community Manager[/i]

notes.title: July Developments Blog
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, how's it going?

Today we’re going to update you on the things we’ve been working on for Relic Hunters Legend in July. There are some new features, fixes and improvements and we hope you like what you’ll see here.

And remember: you can still test our latest Founders build until August 10th at the [url=https://gameround.co/]G. Round platform[/url]! So if you want to play an early Alpha version of the game and give us your feedback, go to the [url=https://gameround.co/]G. Round website[/url] and check how you can join the Playtest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/10a0514e208914912b404c85e5c33f526489e85c.png[/img]

[h1]New Maps and Assets[/h1]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Z5PSd0hF/Relic-Hunters-Concept-Art-Semilla.jpg[/img]

We kept working on the new maps that are going to be implemented on the second and third Acts of Relic Hunters Legend. In the image above you can see some of the assets for [b]Semila City[/b], the richest place in the Galaxy. Fancy or cringe? You decide.

Our alpha players won't be able to see these new maps in-game until launch, but we guarantee it will be awesome to explore every detail present in these new locations.

[h1]The Subway[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/a2adece33f80044960437f9fb6e02eb128091e0a.png[/img]

On Act 2 you will be able to ride the Subway from Hilltown to Semilla City!

During this section, the gameplay camera works differently from the rest of the game, so we worked to implement this new point of view.

[h1]First Pass on the new Game Mode: Delve[/h1]

We’re working on the first pass of the new Game Mode: Delve. These are solo-able Dungeons (but you can also do them with a party if you want to) where you can fight unique Bosses that have dedicated loot tables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/42791f7cfc4b32820813016666190943cc39e813.gif[/img]

You will have limited “Lives” in this Game mode, and the Mission will fail if you lose all of them. Each Boss defeat during your Delve will allow you to regain one Life.

[h1]New Weapons and Gear[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/47af9dfe543d5feb1a8359a251ea9ad3b065058d.gif[/img]

We wanted to give more variety of Weapons and Gears to our players, especially at the first levels of the game, so we developed and implemented more common weapons and new gears with different affixes for our players to enjoy at the very beginning.

[h1]New animated cutscenes on the way![/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/4q64pudbG1XQYskhuP/giphy.gif[/img]

These are also features that are going to be implemented only on the second and third Act of the game, but we’ve already started production on new animated cutscenes! The game’s release will include more than 5 minutes of new animations, and we’re super excited to see how you like them!

[h1]Pause Function[/h1]

Now you can pause the game when playing solo! You can check your backpack or complete an Achievement without worrying about enemies. No more rushing to look at your newly legendary weapons while getting hit by mortars (unless you are in multiplayer, of course!).

[h1]Compare Loot Items[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/M1zywqYML0dFthGy4Y/giphy.gif[/img]

Now it's much easier to compare the equipped loot with the new ones that the player got on the missions. No more memorizing the affixes and rolls on your loot!

[h1]Pinkyy Skins![/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/m9NfVx84y0MIMhzNkV/giphy.gif[/img]

Now Pinkyy also has new clothes to show off to the other Hunters! As you increase your Rebel Rank, you will unlock new Cosmetics. As with other Hunters, you can mix and match the pieces that you like, and also customize their color.

[h1]Dropship Game Mode descriptions[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/tQmPeyJFIlGzySLkl3/giphy.gif[/img]

Now you can find a neat little tutorial for each Game Mode at the Dropship’s computer!

[h1]Rebel Rank Tutorials[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lpSpqx1O7NPH60kRqB/giphy.gif[/img]

We implemented a Tutorial for the Rebel Rank and now it is easier to figure out how the system works. Still needs some polishing, but it’s there! 

[h1]New Options Screen[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TqFB7rC0Tld3FYgvrW/giphy.gif[/img]

A new layout was made for the Options screen that now works with Joystick too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d3841acb4441c7075109a5ba88ea7264e9ca01f9.png[/img]

[h1]Story: Streamlined Dialogues and Dialogue Options![/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xFeKeqwym0BSP4qsAq/giphy.gif[/img]

One of the most consistent feedback that we received from you was that some of the dialogue in the first Act of the game was too long and sometimes a little exhausting to read. We want people to get involved and enjoy the story, so we decided to revise all the dialogue.

We have reduced overall text by 10-20%. We also wanted our players to get a little bit more actively engaged with the story, so we created new dialogue options that will affect the reactions of NPCs according to what you choose. 

[h1]Adventure System[/h1]

We already explained the changes that we made on the Adventure System on the last [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/633080/allnews/]Dev Blog[/url], but we kept improving the system so the players can play a solo mission without leaving their party. This is a massive system change, so we will keep working and polishing for a few months.

[h1]Adventure Multitracking[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/AT57SUoxOqDU4vasGu/giphy.gif[/img]

You can now track multiple Adventures at the same time in your Journal!

[h1]Renaming “Hunter Screen” to “Backpack”[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/cb04ee2adc2d3db86aaba59e48d2de8d89769e45.png[/img]

We decided to change the title of the inventory, at first they were called Hunter Screen but we realize that it’ll be better to keep it simple and now it's a more familiar “Backpack”, with a new icon to boot!

[h1]Gamepad Improvements[/h1]

We have made significant improvements to gamepad navigation on menus, as well as improving the controls on skill usage.

[h1]Chat Improvements[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jBp8c2Deh4j3jflDMU/giphy.gif[/img]

Chat now has a dropdown for private messages and bubbles appear on them to notify the player. There are still some improvements to be made, but now you can chat with your friends easily!


[h1]Checkpoints[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dSGOSINP71woDIj85o/giphy.gif[/img]

One piece of feedback that we got loud and clear was that you hated running back through empty levels if you happened to die at the very end. We have implemented a smarter Checkpoint system that will reduce the amount of running after your party wipes.

[h1]Visual Feedback: Scavenge Drill[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/P6BQEQCk1xfstZpevK/giphy.gif[/img]

Visual feedback for the capture point has been added to the Drill so that you don’t need to look at the UI to check your progress.

[h1]Improved “Basic Melee”[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TS2AyjBa1dDXswX7z5/giphy.gif[/img]

This is a feature that many of our testers didn’t realise even existed! We have made massive changes to it, both in ease of use and in game feel / behavior. There are also new animations and sound. Give those Ducans some proper smackin’!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/3e128f41eecd8965e62be6ed34e94c448f83f2a6.png[/img]


We're still working pretty hard to improve and create awesome things for Relic Hunters Legend, we hope you enjoy what you're seeing so far. Participate in our Discord Channel, we're always there to answer your questions, share some thoughts, and having some fun together!


[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]


Cheers,
Rogue Snail Team.

notes.title: June Developments Blog
notes.content:
Hey hunters, how have you been?

As we promised to our community, we're going to post quick updates at the end of each month to show you what we’re working on in the development of Relic Hunters Legend. Lucy and Mark talked a little bit about the latest news on our last Livestream[b] (you can check it out [url=https://youtu.be/0DNydUl6heM]here[/url])[/b] but we'll go into detail in this post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/3828a711e0161afea18997b5434b9d842d567795.png[/img]

We listened to our alpha players who gave us a lot of valuable feedback and we decided to make some changes:

[h2]Party Transitions[/h2]

We were having some issues with Party transitions between missions: sometimes parties wouldn’t load after a mission ended and players would get stuck at the loading screen; other times some of the party members wouldn’t be able to join a mission. We’ve already fixed this for the next update!

[h2]Adventure System[/h2]

Our Story missions are single-player only, so players needed to leave their parties to start them. This introduced a lot of friction to the multiplayer experience.

Since implementing multiplayer Story missions would be very expensive and might not even be worth it, we’ve decided to make it easier for players to enter these solo activities without having to leave their parties. Hopefully that will be enough, but we’ll keep listening to player feedback after the change is live.

You’ll be able to do any Secret Market story content by just entering the multiplayer hub  talking to NPCs:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/FPKqnuzgTsuYCBaeC3/giphy.gif[/img]

While one player does their solo Story mission, other party members can do whatever they want at the Secret Market while they wait - including starting their own Story content! We call this “phasing”, and effectively puts players into a solo instance of the Market while they complete their Story activities.

We will also allow you to start and track multiple Adventures at the same time.

And finally, we will allow party members to play solo Story missions outside of the Secret Market without leaving their parties as well. Players who are doing Story missions at another location will be marked as “In Another Activity” on the Social screen, and will re-join their Party as soon as the Story mission is over!

[h2]Backend Migration[/h2]

We are moving all data and code from our existing backend service to another platform. This is very unfortunate, but there is no way around it. Our current backend platform will be shutting down next year, so we need to make the move.

This is a boring, technical and long process. Thankfully our Mysterious Strangers are giving us all the support we need to do it safely and as quickly as possible. Even then, this will take a lot of work, and will also require us to wipe all current save files from our Alpha players.

We apologize for this wipe, since it was not our intention, but unfortunately there is no other alternative at this point. So don’t get too attached to your perfectly-rolled Legendaries :(

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/10a0514e208914912b404c85e5c33f526489e85c.png[/img]

[h2]Second Act of the Story of Relic Hunters Legend[/h2]

We’re working on Act 2 of the Story of Relic Hunters Legend. On the previous update our Alpha players were able to play the entire First Act and the feedback has been great! We are almost done with Act 2, but we won’t release it for Alpha players - both Act 2 and Act 3 will be a surprise that will not be spoiled until release!

[h2]New Maps and Assets - Hilltown and Old Town[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/264b827898d483518cb2a97597a18d57784b4a02.png[/img]

We’ll have new Regions for our players to explore, such as Hilltown, which is part of the new Act 2 content.

[h2]Distraction Game mode prototype done[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/8e13cd30a9a2898f593a57ec07901c6431a102b4.gif[/img]

We’ve finished the prototype of the new Game Mode: Distraction. In this game mode waves of enemies patrol around areas and seek out nearby players to attack. The players need to keep an “Alert Meter” full by defeating enemies all the time. It's a super intense game mode! However, the player can't get too distracted by the waves of enemies and lose focus of the Elite enemies that appear randomly and that matters most for the Alert Meter progression! The lowest the Alert Meter bar is at the end of the mission, the smaller the rewards.

[h2]Defense Game Mode prototype done[/h2]

Defense Game Mode is in development. In this game mode, you will need to defend your Loot Chests from waves of enemies that spawn on the different lanes of the map. Special “Gatecrashers” enemies will spawn and move directly towards the Chests to destroy them. Regular enemies will also appear, but their focus will be distracting and defeating players to help the Gatecrashers reach the chests. Players must focus on taking down the Gatecrashers to advance to the next rounds, but they need to find the best strategy to make it work without losing their Chests!

[h2]New SFX and VO[/h2]

More sound effects have been added to our stores, resources, chests, and scoreboard. New Enemy voice overs were also implemented.

[h2]New Enemies and more variations of Kami[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/1cc62f627aca4829199d530a7d347351bce37f23.gif[/img]

We created new enemies and new variations of Kami! Increasing enemy variety in the game is one of our priorities, and hopefully you will get plenty of different baddies to shoot at when the game is released!

[h2]Gear Score Rank Skins[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/053ed71caecae74956dca19a475ccdcb9bcc0eb5.png[/img]

We wanted to make player progression more fun and visually exciting! We’re implementing Gear Score Rank Skins: whenever you reach a new Gear Score Rank (such as Common I or Rare I) you will get a visual upgrade for that Hunter! The cool thing about this is that you are not locked into a specific look - you can mix and match pieces, change their colors individually, and have your Hunters always look the way you want them to.

[h2]New Chat Tabs and overall improvements[/h2]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/EViVlrSmyjB3ekCS2A/giphy.gif[/img]

We improved our player experience with the Global Chat, now they’re able to talk only to their party, whisper to their friends and look for a group to play with! We will also have a Trade chat in the future, and implement spam protection on public channels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/25b2ced71cb3e2d97ab4a899845d383f8511647d.png[/img]

We fixed a lot of bugs that our players found in the previous update, such as:

[list]
[*] Fixed getting stuck after the Kami Queen battle, even if the Champion was defeated.
[*] Fixed the Kami Queen not using some of her skills. She will now summon several Kami Kaze during the battle and become stronger when at low health.
[*] Fixed the Cobran Captain dealing only 1 damage with their attacks. 
[*] Fixed Lt. Susan’s shotgun only being shot at a very close range.
[*] Fixed a bug where some achievements were not unlocked when getting some specific legendary weapons or gear.
[*] Fixed Jimmy losing his accessories after unequipping them.
[*] Fixed bug where weapons stopped working at Coldstone Peaks missions.
[*] Fixed issue that prevented players from exiting the Scoreboard if their Ultimate Skill was triggered right when the Mission was ending
[*] Fixed an issue where gamepad input would stop working on the map screen if you moved your mouse while in gamepad mode.
[*] Fixed various visual bugs.
[*] Fixed various SFX issues.
[/list]

And there are many more things to come! Keep following us on social media, join our Discord Channel to hang out with us and ask your questions about Relic Hunters - we’re always there to assist you and our community loves to make new friends <3

[url=https://discord.com/invite/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]

Cheers ~
[i]Rogue Snail Team[/i]

notes.title: The long-awaited update has arrived! 10h+ of gameplay and MORE!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters, how have you been?

We’re here to deliver some really awesome news: the new Update is [b]OUT[/b] for all our founders/backers to play! Now our most loyal supporters can enjoy [b]10+ hours of gameplay[/b], including main adventures, side quests, and all multiplayer missions of [b]the first act of Relic Hunters Legend[/b]! We worked pretty hard to make this build, we tested out many things, we cried, laughed, designed, implemented, coded, tested a little bit more, and now we’re sure that you’re gonna enjoy it!

We know it’s been a while since we updated you on what’s going on, but it was for good reasons! We decided to keep the secrets of this new update close to our chest until now so we could get really effective feedback from our community. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/8b39cd8033fdba0fc04dfbbdad66ecbd442f94f3.png[/img]


We’re also interested in learning more about the games you like to play and what are the features you like or dislike about them. This survey will help us understand a little bit more about your expectations and will help us shape Relic Hunters Legend into an awesome game!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/6c7acdab96b8718c7798140a08d04414c4cb4ece.jpg[/img]


Fill out this [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/JKVDCG2]survey[/url] to help us understand what are the things you look for in the games you play. After finishing the questionnaire, talk to LucyG | CM on our [url=http://discord.gg/relichunters]Discord Community[/url] to get an exclusive Wallpaper and the DIY of Spaceheart’s Papercraft!


[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/JKVDCG2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/48a6ad94dfea48cb824ce640bc532fdbb243bcf4.png[/img][/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/93098a1b61399f2459e1b7250d29cfcafce2a5a9.png[/img]


[b]So, what's new in Relic Hunters Legend? [/b]

Well, you're going to face a whole new game from what you were used to, and here's the [i]~ small ~[/i] list of new features implemented to date:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e203b122f10fa52c68086489b6ba1cd7688c25b2.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/h8T3k8O0pXrymlla24/giphy.gif[/img]

Now our players can enjoy more than 10 hours of gameplay to complete [b]all[/b] of the Main Adventures  and Side Adventures, plus all of the multiplayer Missions in the first act. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/80327e5699b1d6946491a7f593f60a03aeda5064.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/bznOgqmp0TevoqVWAc/giphy.gif[/img]

After complete the first two Story missions our players will be able to watch the [b]new introduction cutscene[/b]. It’s super awesome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/1e09812661718a4c95efbd57227729e05af75db0.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/vloBpt4ihkTE6xH6za/giphy.gif[/img]

Now you have your Journal screen to choose which Adventure (quests) you want to play! Besides the main Adventures that tell the story of Seven, there are 8 side Adventures with small fun stories, including characters like Biu and Panzer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e3d86b59b866f59ca375b3c10ca10143f3e41a15.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/2bc0555027489e84b57f073459d4e44f0db246d0.jpg[/img]

After you clear 9 regular Missions, you unlock the Special Missions, which rotate every 20 minutes and provide guaranteed rewards and higher difficulty! Also, you can talk with every Hunter in the galaxy or chill out only with your friends with the new chat system! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/ad13361b28f5f1fa2679102f330c5aff49d8d963.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7Eqs7hiKkcyop4jwyH/giphy.gif[/img]

Now you can make your own build for your Hunter and enhace your battle style. Active skills are no longer all available from level 1 - you’ll need to unlock them as you level up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/aeb5e0fa18d01b1a00ef392084d6faa56f002d46.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/5c9f2dc48a15218be1199b8e3ba9a1b2913fb82b.png[/img]
Tons of new items including Legendaries, Exotics, Augmented, and Set items to collect in your adventures! Conquer the best of the best and be the most powerful Hunter in the galaxy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/01524b1dfffc508650ec1cd54af37cc51a60c4b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/839b27986a2441ba6b3e577ce621dc16b3308161.jpg[/img]

With a lot more interesting effects for Gear and Weapons to strengthen your builds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/1661c48b685bbd3b1d6ef2e127d5cff7631d1a47.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/MT3lKlzNNGnsvfyaYh/giphy.gif[/img]

Now you have the place to find your quests, friends, buy new equipment at Shops and keep your items in your Storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/0df07b2e0c3a4aba8e3307a34c5ca8801bc2239a.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1VMddlWxar7QTtlBTF/giphy.gif[/img]

Invite your friends from your Steam Account to play with you! You will stick together after missions are completed and can keep playing together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/d3c9493f1d620d233c9eb61cbf0eec41e63624dc.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/aNnYbVeljIPnPK5k2r/giphy.gif[/img]

The customizations are already implemented with color palettes for every hunter! Jimmy has a few test cosmetics at the moment, including hats, hair, clothes, and accessories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/9141414ecdd3a061dc501a640cb3531aaf1f7f34.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rmAQrqwPJqkN1YUavW/giphy.gif[/img]

We have Emotes and Emojis inside the game now, which you can combine to express yourself in multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e3ad595be58a0f2235f893efa79cfb66b28df82c.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/UYocPtrnp5pxw6Msk3/giphy.gif[/img]

You can get guaranteed rewards such as equipment and materials after completing the stages of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f4ccde0a9ab58d5b0861261c65f46ca0e5c2703a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/dc5d4dd041a06a64402fc6646c20008bacf4c1af.gif[/img]

Now we have [b]Chests and Resource Nodes[/b] for you to find and grab loot and materials! They can be found in the world in many ways: as a reward for beating a mission, guarded by some Ducans, or even hidden away in some tight weird corner of the map. Chests and Resource Nodes are a new way to get some nice loot and materials for your Hunters! The Regular chests and the Resources also [b]respawn every 24h[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/84e1689d13c34da3edc9e68a2eb3ffafabe33254.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5j8fckmTbBhqnxHor8/giphy.gif[/img]

Now we have a Galaxy Screen! Before, you only had access to The Planet Cradle, where you could find the already known missions and hubs (like Galyno Desert, Secret Market, Peaks Blockade, etc). Now you can choose between the Cradle and yet-to-be-developed secrets. In the future, we hope to expand our universe even further so we added this very special screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/caefad004d4677c7c7accd390c4f260c7d02626e.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LXzjZ1a4R9TA2mm7jq/giphy.gif[/img]

A new and polished MapScreen has been made. More details and even more beautiful with [b]5 new Missions[/b] for you to explore, with different scenarios for you to defeat the enemies that will surround you. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e62b17685de8c02559e5488dc906b0bedb88e18f.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BDtswKE0ORZY4tE2v9/giphy.gif[/img]

Now we have [b]four game modes[/b] implemented for you to enjoy alongside the quests and side quests that you’re able to get on Secret Market with our fellow Hunters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/29d6fe1bc27b4b6eb7b676fede2f1e261954cb6d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/167b013bc77bdcc3900bc7cd2c752a564abf2f0c.png[/img]

New bosses and enemies were implemented with different behaviors and abilities. Tired of fighting the Ducan Demolisher over and over again? We already have The Riotbreakers, Lt Susan, Cobran Captain and Kami Queen done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/8c6351304979ee42074ca218e367c442ce71928e.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jaOpviXFr1FRahvyv1/giphy.gif[/img]

All our playable characters now have their own unique Ultimate Skill implemented! Go punch Ducans with Pinkyy’s Gauntlets, freeze enemies with Seven’s vortex, Shoot them like a crazy hurricane with Jimmy or enjoy some Beats and gain buffs with Raff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/fcb971ef238ec7d33cb5fae4eb2d6eb2a8c79d72.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/MidvH5Tkf5ANrErJ1t/giphy.gif[/img]

Complete achievements and increase your Rebel Rank! This will give you special benefits to ease and further your hunting experience, like increasing the size of your storage, rewarding specific gear and weapons to show out your hunter experience, adding extra load-outs, or even giving you extra bounties to spend at the Market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/30fb5536b31f87ab7b041ca74f9ccc9622b50742.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1IYtaxuBtXYwl2vq6g/giphy.gif[/img]

Gather with your friends while you prepare your hunters for the battle on our new lobby system, getting easier to manage the party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/27767103e51e3e6f8b5801655e0f7e63b07ababa.png[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rMTORYRPmLjKroW6BD/giphy.gif[/img]

At the end of each mission you can check who was the MVP among your friends and endorse your favorite teammates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/7e4b53dfdc0729019ab4f526d21b1aeeb230cfc1.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Many new music tracks and sound effects[/b]
[*] [b]Visual improvements[/b]: with new visual effects and lighting
[*] [b]Account Backend system[/b]: you can create your account and all of your progress is saved on the cloud. It is no longer possible to cheat your items and persistent progress in the game, which will open the way for one of our most exciting features soon: [b]player Trading![/b] For now, you don't need to insert your real email address to create an account, but further on the development this will be needed! We'll keep you updated about it :)

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/15f08a00892ead6a1c2970713c3249a1bf5d89c1.png[/img]

There are a few annoying things that we already know about this new update, but we feel like we should deploy it to you sooner rather than later. We are very excited to see what you think about it, but we’re already looking into it to fix it for the next update! 

Also, for you to be able to test the capstones of your skill trees, the Rebel Rank 5 is giving you a lot more skill points for you to spend and test out new builds.

So, without further ado, here are the list of the Known Issues that you can face in your gameplay:


===========

[list]
[*]  Loading times become progressively longer as you play and eventually crash. We recommend closing and re-opening the game every 60 minutes.
[*]  Getting stuck on "Party Transition" is common. ALT+F4 out of the game if it happens.
[*]  Sometimes invisible holes show up on the ground. Don't bother to screenshot the holes because they are random.
[*]  Soft lock sometimes when opening menus during cutscenes
[*]  If the party leader leaves during a Skirmish mission, the mission may not advance to the next round
[*]  The final fight of the Alpha (lvl 22 Cobran Captain) is very bugged and broken and will be fixed on a future patch
[/list]

These quality-of-life Features [b]WILL come soon[/b], no need to suggest them:

===========
[list]
[*] Item Compare functionality
[*] Complete Stats Screen
[*] "Lock" Item / "Favorite" Item functionality
[*] Mass Recycle
[*] Auto-Recycle with Loot Filter
[*] Storage tabs
[*] Storage sorting
[*] Storage search
[*] For now the level cap is 15, but at the final launch the máx. level will be 60!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/c173685a2eac11bb2ba1e1cbda4d5576507670e3.png[/img]


This build is a huge step for us and It'll be the last chance to make [b]big[/b] changes into Relic Hunters Legend if it's needed. So we're asking for our alpha supporters to help us and give us as much feedback as possible for us to keep developing a great game. You can make it on our Steam Forums or in our Discord Community, take screenshots, record gameplay, the way you're going to do it is your choice but we [b]really[/b] need to see with our own eyes how this experience is going for you.

Participate in our [url=discord.gg/relichunters]Discord Community[/url], it’s easier to talk to us, give us feedback and share experiences with other Hunters there!


[url=discord.gg/relichunters][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/e8ecbcf4ccaf65498d1da527af9fc4f3519d5f18.png[/img][/url]




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/3e128f41eecd8965e62be6ed34e94c448f83f2a6.png[/img]


So what do you think? We hope you appreciate what you’re going to see and experience, we’re still working on new features and optimizations but we’re anxious to hear your thoughts about it, so we can continue to shape this game with our awesome community! 


Have a nice hunt,

Cheers~
from all Rogue Snail Team.

notes.title: What we were doing so far and the future of Relic Hunters Legend!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RGWEVtf_KhM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Hunters,

We’ve been quiet for a while. In fact, we’ve been quiet for longer than we have ever been since this community was founded in 2015 - the year we released Relic Hunters Zero. 

Our silence was entirely due to [b]good reasons[/b], though, and today I’d like to share some of the good news with you.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YOYhDYaEsfduRcQ5Sm/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]So gather around everyone because we're about to reveal our plans[/i]

As you know, we’ve been pouring our hearts and souls into this project for 3 years now. It is a [b]gigantic project for indie standards[/b]: a sprawling online game with several characters, deep storytelling and lore, and dozens of features and mechanics. It is our dream game, and [b]dreams are not easy to achieve[/b]. 

This year was supposed to be our deadline: we would have to release whatever we had into Early Access and hope for the best. If the game didn’t do well, our dream was in risk of being cut short. We’d have to let people go. We’d be back to our situation in 2017, before Kickstarter, when we had no money and just a handful of people trying to make this dream a reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/f86df8d7bb934edebe05ffacb6bd8b395e0ba36b.jpg[/img]
[i]What if we don’t find any partner? ;([/i]

It was a daunting challenge, but one we were ready to face anyway. Rebels don’t need to fight alone, though, and sometimes being brave is being willing to accept that you need backup.

We’re happy to announce that we found the perfect backup, and our rebel crew has grown. We have just signed with a partner that will help us fund the rest of the game’s development, and help us bring Relic Hunters to millions of fans around the world!

For now, they will remain anonymous. Let’s call them [i]“Mysterious Strangers”[/i]. This partnership will be fully announced and revealed next year, so stay tuned. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/JohhaG3zRh9eVGutzO/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]The Mysterious Strangers coming to help us develop an even better Relic Hunters Legend[/i]

Here’s how everything else is looking for the next 2 years of Relic Hunters:

[list]
[*] The game [b]won’t[/b] be coming out on Steam Early Access this year. We will announce the new release date next year;
[*] We are still in [b]full control[/b] of the game and the IP. This is still a game owned and shaped by its community;
[*] The Founders program will [b]no longer be available for new Founders[/b]. We will stop selling Founder packs on[b] August 31st, at 12:00 Pacific Time[/b]. All of our promises, perks and privileges to pre-existing Founders will be kept.
[*] We have no exclusive platform or console deals in place. Relic Hunters will come out in as many stores and consoles as possible;
[*] We are still building the game as Free-to-Play;
[*] Our team size is almost doubling, from [b]17 to 30 people[/b]. This means more quality, more content, and more love being put into the game;
[*] We now have the resources to deliver our full vision for Relic Hunters on launch day, instead of having to rely on Early Access being successful;
[*] There are [b]new Comics underway [/b]- we have 60 pages done and even more in development;
[*] [i]Even more secret cool stuff coming soon![/i]
[/list]

[h1]New Alpha updates[/h1]

So, if you’re a Founder, you haven’t seen a new Alpha update since PAX East in February. This is also for a good reason: we are finishing [b]the entire first Act of the game[/b], and we wanted to wrap it up entirely before presenting it to you.

We felt that releasing the first Act little by little would prevent you from having a fresh perspective on the experience as a whole. We want you to have a different point of view than we have, so we decided to hold off until a big chunk of the game is done before allowing you all in. We want feedback and we are prepared to make big changes in response to your opinions and feelings about the first act. It is between [b]5-8 hours of gameplay [/b]and it is coming this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30762043/72974a280669b94249e942746af700809e9653aa.png[/img]
[i]Panzer and Biu are being developed and they’re excited to start their adventures in the Legend’s Galaxy![/i]

As always, we still offer full refunds with no questions asked for any and all of our Founders. If you feel like this is taking too long, we understand and accept it. Just keep in mind that [b]the Founders program will close to new purchases on August 31st at 12:00 Pacific Time[/b].

We would never have gotten this far without you. We will be forever grateful for all the love and support this community has shown us through all the hardships and achievements of the past 3 years.

Keep following us on our Social Media and participate on our Discord Channel, we’re always there to talk and share some details about the development of our projects.

Thank you. The journey is only just beginning.

Cheers,

~ Lucy, Mark, Betu, and the Relic Hunters Team.

notes.title: Open Development Week #118: Story Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hey Hunters,

How have you been?

It's been too long since our last update, but I hope it was worth the wait - we finally have our Story content available for the first time [b]EVER![/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/028/138/652/bf5348d30913f3cc84791e14eebac36b_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1582044613&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1b5701bc62d2192f55cccf9156409e9f[/img]
[i]Meet The Professor and many new characters[/i]

This is a very brief preview, showing the opening of the game and the two first Story missions. It should last between 40-60 minutes to go through.

[h1]Combat Changes[/h1]

This is also the official release of our Combat 2.0 Update. It brings a LOT of core changes to how combat, skills and enemies work. You can get the full rundown on our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/daevo/relic-hunters-legend-online-cooperative-shooter-lo/posts/2679457][b]last update about it[/b][/url].

Team up and set up some cool [b]Combos![/b]

[h1]New Hunter: Seven[/h1]

Last but not least, we have a new character in the game, with their full skill kit: Seven, the Time-Traveller.

Seven can be customized by you when the game starts, choosing gender and Star Sign. In the future, Star Signs will be meaningful for gameplay - but for now they are just flavor, pick whatever you want!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/028/138/517/ad8391430c9b607e2f5e8e16016ec9b5_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1582043967&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=aed0c73af424ff4389a4601a8beb743e[/img]
[i]Seven charging the Maelstrom skill [/i]

Here's a rundown of Seven's kit:

[h3]Blink[/h3]

Seven blinks forward in time. Has 3 Uses. Blinking through enemies marks them with Paradox Mark.

[h3]Shift Strike[/h3]

Seven jumps forward in time to punch an enemy, dealing 150 Water damage. Marked enemies are Frozen for 3 seconds. This skill is an Elemental Combo Detonator.

[h3]Re:Alignment[/h3]

Recovers Seven’s Shields instantly. All nearby Marked enemies explode with Water damage. All nearby enemies with Paradox Mark take 100 Water damage.

[h3]Paradox Mark[/h3]

Enemies hit by Seven’s skills may receive a Paradox Mark which reduces their damage output by 30% and triggers special effects from some of Seven’s skills.

[h3]Maelstrom[/h3]

Seven charges a powerful void rift that pulls enemies into it before exploding. This skill can be charged to become more powerful. Pulls enemies in for 1 second and Mark every one with Paradox Mark. The explosion Primes enemies for a Combo. The explosion deals 100/140/180 Water damage.

[h1]This year is just beginning![/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/028/138/575/aa7b524f2b690f1092345e85b681f117_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1582044256&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f7d2b70600e8864acfcb4b2f45bcc334[/img]

You will meet new allies, new enemies, face the fearsome Supreme Commander Krek and the mysterious Timekeepers. All in due time.
